chatgpt: ChatGPT is an AI conversation assistant developed by OpenAI, with over 200 million users worldwide and one of the most influential AI products to date. Powered by the GPT-4o model, it supports multimodal interactions including text, images, and files, capable of handling writing, coding, analysis, translation, and virtually any text-based task. Its plugin store and GPTs ecosystem allow users to build custom AI assistants for specialized use cases. ChatGPT offers both free and Plus paid tiers, with Plus users getting priority access to the latest models. From students to entrepreneurs to enterprise teams, ChatGPT has become an indispensable intelligent assistant in everyday workflows.
claude: Claude is an AI assistant developed by Anthropic, renowned for its exceptional long-context understanding and code generation capabilities, supporting up to 200K token context windows for processing entire books or large codebases. Anthropic leads the industry in safety alignment research, and Claude excels at following instructions and refusing harmful requests. Claude 3.5 Sonnet surpasses GPT-4 on multiple coding and reasoning benchmarks, particularly in complex analysis, academic writing, and long document summarization. Available in free and Claude Pro paid tiers, it is the preferred AI tool for users prioritizing safety and high-quality output.
midjourney: Midjourney is the world's most popular AI image generation tool, celebrated for its stunning artistic styles and exceptional output quality. Users can generate professional-grade illustrations, concept art, and photorealistic images simply by entering text descriptions. The V6 model significantly improves realism and detail, offering more precise prompt control. Midjourney boasts an active Discord community of millions of creators sharing artworks and prompt techniques. Currently subscription-based, it is ideal for designers, game artists, brand creative teams, and anyone passionate about visual creation.
cursor: Cursor is a code editor designed for the AI era, built on the VS Code foundation with top-tier models like Claude and GPT-4 built in. Its signature Tab completion predicts and auto-completes multiple lines of code, while Composer mode enables synchronized edits across multiple files for efficient complex refactoring. Cursor supports generating code from natural language descriptions and semantic search across entire codebases. Now used by millions of developers worldwide, it is one of the most impactful AI tools for boosting coding productivity, available in free and Pro paid tiers.
deepseek: DeepSeek is China's most prominent AI model, developed by High-Flyer. Its R1 reasoning model matches GPT-4 in mathematics, coding, and logical reasoning while being completely free to use, attracting global attention. DeepSeek employs a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, outperforming comparable models in training cost and inference efficiency. It supports web chat, API access, and open-source local deployment, catering to developers, researchers, and enterprise users. Its Chinese language comprehension and generation capabilities are particularly strong, making it one of the best AI choices for Chinese-language applications.
suno: Suno is the world's leading AI music generation platform, enabling users to create complete professional-quality songs with vocals and full instrumentation within seconds by simply entering lyrics, style descriptions, or mood keywords. Suno v3 delivers audio quality rivaling commercial production standards and supports a wide range of genres from pop and rock to classical and electronic. No musical background is required — anyone can create complete songs with ease. Offering free credits and subscription plans, it has been embraced by millions of creators, content producers, and music enthusiasts, fundamentally lowering the barrier to music creation.
spotify: Spotify is the world's largest music streaming platform, featuring over 100 million songs and 5 million podcast episodes, with more than 600 million monthly active users. Its personalized recommendation algorithm accurately captures user tastes and generates custom playlists weekly. Spotify supports playback across PC, mobile, tablet, and smart speakers, offering free (ad-supported) and Premium ad-free high-quality tiers. Its podcast capabilities continue to expand, making it the world's largest podcast distribution platform. For music lovers, Spotify is the essential tool for discovering new music, managing playlists, and following favorite artists.
instagram: Instagram, owned by Meta, is the world's most popular photo and short video social platform with over 2 billion monthly active users. Users can share photos, short Reels videos, and Stories with powerful filters and editing tools. Instagram is a core platform for brand marketing, influencer economy, and creative showcase, with shopping features enabling in-app purchases. Reels has seen explosive growth, with algorithmic recommendations helping creators reach wider audiences. For personal brand building, photography enthusiasts, and e-commerce sellers, Instagram is an indispensable social marketing platform.
perplexity: Perplexity AI is a next-generation AI-powered search engine that retrieves real-time information from the web and delivers precise, source-cited answers in a clear format, widely regarded as a powerful challenger to Google. Unlike traditional search engines, Perplexity answers questions directly rather than returning link lists, dramatically reducing information filtering time. It supports follow-up questions and multi-turn conversations, ideal for deep research, academic reference, and quick fact-checking. Available in free and Pro tiers (accessing GPT-4, Claude, and other top models), it is an efficient information tool for researchers, students, and knowledge workers.
discord: Discord started as an instant messaging tool for gamers and has grown into the world's largest interest-based community platform with over 500 million registered users. Its Server system supports text channels, voice channels, video calls, and live streaming with an incredibly rich ecosystem. From gaming guilds to AI research communities, investment discussions to study groups, Discord covers virtually every niche interest. Its Bot system enables automation and feature extensions, while Nitro paid tier offers higher quality video and custom emojis. It is the top platform for building private communities, hosting online events, and managing fan engagement.
substack: Substack is a newsletter and paid subscription platform for independent creators, enabling writers to reach readers directly and monetize their work without traditional media intermediaries. Creators can publish text, podcasts, and video content, with readers choosing free or paid subscriptions to unlock premium content. Substack takes only a 10% platform fee on paid subscriptions with no advertising revenue sharing, keeping creator earnings transparent and predictable. Thousands of creators already earn over $100,000 annually on the platform. For journalists, researchers, industry analysts, and niche experts, Substack is the premier independent media platform for building personal brands and cultivating loyal readership.
strava: Strava is the world's most popular sports social platform, focused on data tracking and community interaction for outdoor activities like running, cycling, and swimming. Users record workout routes via GPS, automatically logging pace, distance, elevation, and heart rate in detail, with social features for friend interactions and kudos. Strava's Segment feature lets users compete against global athletes on the same route, adding competitive excitement. Available in free and Summit paid tiers, with paid access unlocking detailed training analysis and personalized training plans. It is the essential tool for runners, cyclists, and fitness enthusiasts to track their progress and connect with a global athletic community.
twitter: X (formerly Twitter) is the world's most influential real-time information social platform, essential for the tech community, media professionals, politicians, and entrepreneurs. Users post short messages (tweets), images, and videos for real-time discussions, with trending topics rapidly aggregating through hashtags. After Elon Musk's acquisition and rebranding to X, new features like long-form posts and paid subscriptions were introduced, with Blue verification attracting quality creators. X Premium offers longer posts, priority reply sorting, and reduced ads. It remains the core platform for tracking global real-time events and participating in public discourse.
linkedin: LinkedIn is the world's largest professional social network with over 1 billion registered users across 200+ countries and regions. Users showcase resumes, share professional updates, expand industry connections, and communicate directly with recruiters. LinkedIn's job posting function is one of the top channels globally for companies to post positions and find talent, with smart recommendations matching job seekers to suitable roles. LinkedIn Learning offers thousands of professional courses for skill development. For professionals, HR practitioners, and B2B marketers, LinkedIn is the core platform for building professional influence and career opportunities.
telegram: Telegram is a cross-platform instant messaging app renowned for its security and speed, offering end-to-end encrypted secret chats along with supergroups of up to 200,000 members and broadcast channels. Compared to other messaging apps, Telegram supports file transfers up to 2GB and has an extremely rich Bot ecosystem. Channel features are widely used for content publishing, community management, and information subscriptions, making it the preferred broadcast channel for media outlets, project teams, and community operators. Telegram is completely free with no advertising, with globally distributed servers ensuring speed. It leads mainstream messaging tools in both privacy protection and feature richness.
runway: Runway is a pioneer in AI video generation and editing, with its Gen-2 and Gen-3 models capable of transforming text descriptions or images directly into high-quality videos, revolutionizing film production and creative advertising. Beyond video generation, Runway provides professional post-processing tools including background removal, video restoration, and motion tracking, building a complete AI video creation workflow. It has collaborated with multiple Hollywood production teams for film visual effects and commercial production. Available with free trial credits and subscription paid tiers, it is an important AI tool for creative professionals, video bloggers, and professional film and video production teams.
canva: Canva is an online graphic design platform for non-professional designers, offering over 1 million ready-made templates covering social media graphics, presentations, posters, business cards, and virtually any design need. Its drag-and-drop interface is extremely intuitive, allowing anyone without design skills to create professional-looking designs. Canva supports real-time team collaboration with built-in AI features for one-click image generation, background modification, and copy optimization. Available in free and Canva Pro paid tiers, with Pro unlocking premium templates, brand kits, and team features. Used by over 100 million users globally, it is the preferred design tool for small businesses, content creators, and educators.
figma: Figma is the industry-standard UI/UX design tool supporting real-time multi-user collaborative editing, fundamentally transforming how design teams work. Its browser-based architecture requires no local software installation, with design files stored in the cloud for access anywhere. Figma features a powerful component system, auto-layout, and variables, suitable for designing everything from small apps to complex enterprise products. The plugin ecosystem is extensive with deep integrations for Jira, Notion, Slack, and other tools. Dev Mode enables developers to extract code parameters directly from design files, dramatically improving design-development collaboration efficiency, making it the core tool for product teams.
framer: Framer is an AI-powered website design and publishing platform that enables designers to create websites with professional-grade animations and interactive experiences without writing code, then publish them directly online. Its AI features can automatically generate page layouts from text descriptions, dramatically lowering the barrier to building websites. Framer supports rich animation effects, responsive design, and custom domains, ideal for creative studios, product landing pages, and personal portfolio sites. Available in free starter and professional paid tiers, with paid plans supporting custom domains and more pages. It is one of the best solutions for designers to build websites independently without relying on development teams.
behance: Behance, owned by Adobe, is the world's largest platform for showcasing creative work, bringing together millions of designers, illustrators, photographers, and creatives from over 190 countries. Designers showcase portfolios, find inspiration, and build professional reputations here, while companies and headhunters discover talent through Behance. The platform is deeply integrated with Adobe Creative Cloud, allowing work to be published in one click from Photoshop, Illustrator, and other applications. Job features allow creative professionals to directly apply for relevant positions. For designers, maintaining a well-curated Behance profile is an important pathway for building a personal brand and accessing career opportunities.
spline: Spline is a browser-based 3D design tool that enables designers to create stunning three-dimensional scenes, interactive animations, and real-time rendered effects without specialized 3D software experience. Its intuitive interface supports drag-and-drop modeling, material editing, and animation timelines, with works directly embeddable in web pages or exportable as video. Spline has become a popular tool for web designers creating immersive visual experiences, with countless product websites and creative projects using Spline for 3D hero sections. Available in free and professional paid tiers, with paid plans supporting team collaboration and advanced export options.
github: GitHub is the world's largest code hosting and developer collaboration platform, with over 100 million registered developers and hundreds of millions of repositories. Built on the Git version control system, it provides complete collaboration workflows including branch management, Pull Requests, and Code Review. GitHub Actions offers built-in CI/CD automation pipelines, while Copilot AI provides real-time code suggestions. It is the core infrastructure of the open source community, hosting top projects like Linux, React, and Python. Available in free personal and paid team/enterprise tiers, it is a core tool every developer must master.
vercel: Vercel is a cloud deployment and hosting platform built specifically for frontend developers, officially backed by the Next.js framework, delivering exceptional developer experience (DX). Every code push automatically triggers builds and deployments, with global edge network distribution enabling static sites and Serverless functions to go live in seconds. Preview deployments generate unique preview links for each Pull Request, dramatically improving team collaboration and review efficiency. Built-in analytics, Web Vitals monitoring, and A/B testing are included. Offering a generous free Hobby plan and Pro paid tier for teams, it is the preferred deployment platform for modern frontend projects.
replit: Replit is a fully-featured browser-based online IDE supporting over 50 programming languages, allowing users to write, run, and deploy code directly without any local environment setup. Its AI feature Ghostwriter provides code completion and explanations, ideal for programming beginners getting started quickly. Replit supports real-time multi-user collaborative editing with built-in databases, custom domains, and deployment capabilities, enabling the complete journey from zero to live entirely in a browser. Widely used in educational settings for creating programming courses and assignment environments. Available in free and Replit Core paid tiers, it is the ideal tool for rapid prototyping and programming education.
postman: Postman is the world's most popular API development and testing tool, with over 30 million developer users. It provides an intuitive graphical interface for sending HTTP requests, viewing responses, and debugging endpoints, supporting REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, and other protocols. Postman's Collection feature organizes and manages API requests, with environment variables supporting switching between different deployment environments. Automated test scripts integrate into CI/CD pipelines, and API documentation can be auto-generated and shared in one click. Available in free personal and team collaboration paid tiers, it is an indispensable debugging tool in the daily workflow of frontend and backend developers.
stackoverflow: Stack Overflow is the world's largest developer Q&A community, with over 100 million monthly visitors covering questions and answers for virtually every programming language and technology stack. Developers ask questions, provide answers, and vote on content here, with quality answers accumulating into a vast searchable technical knowledge base. A reputation scoring system incentivizes high-quality content contributions, while a badge system recognizes specialized expertise. Stack Overflow for Teams offers private knowledge bases for internal enterprise use. For any developer, Stack Overflow is the first stop for solving technical problems and an important community resource for technical learning and growth.
codepen: CodePen is an online code laboratory and community platform for frontend developers, providing a real-time preview editing environment for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript without any local setup required. Developers create and share Pens (code snippets) ranging from CSS animation effects to complete JavaScript components. The CodePen community is a rich source of creative inspiration, making it an excellent place for learning frontend techniques, discovering new technologies, and showcasing personal skills. Supports preprocessors and frameworks including Sass, TypeScript, and Vue. Available in free and Pro paid tiers, with Pro supporting private Pens and team collaboration.
notion: Notion is a powerful all-in-one workspace that combines notes, documents, databases, project management, and wikis into a single platform. Its block editor supports dozens of content types including text, images, code, tables, and kanban boards, flexibly combined to meet any need. Notion AI automatically generates summaries, translates content, and assists with writing. The template library offers hundreds of ready-made solutions from personal journals to team OKR management. Available in personal free and team paid tiers, it is used by millions of individuals and teams worldwide as a core knowledge management and collaboration tool, making it one of the most influential productivity products.
slack: Slack is an enterprise instant messaging and team collaboration platform that replaces traditional email with a Channel-based workflow for more efficient and organized team communication. It supports messaging, file sharing, voice and video calls, with deep integration for over 2,600 third-party apps including Google Drive, Jira, and GitHub. Slack Connect enables cross-company collaboration, while Workflow Builder supports no-code process automation. Available in free (with message history limits) and professional paid tiers. Acquired by Salesforce and continuously expanding enterprise features, it is the standard communication tool for Silicon Valley tech companies and startup teams.
trello: Trello is an intuitive kanban-style project management tool that visualizes task workflows through drag-and-drop cards, with zero learning curve for teams to get started quickly. Each Board contains multiple lists, with cards supporting due dates, attachments, checklists, labels, and member assignments. Power-Up features support integrations with Google Drive, Slack, Jira, and other tools. An Atlassian product, it forms a complete collaboration suite with Jira and Confluence. Available in a feature-rich free tier and paid tiers unlocking advanced features, it is particularly well-suited for small teams, personal project management, and content creation workflow tracking.
airtable: Airtable is the perfect fusion of spreadsheet and database, enabling non-technical users to build powerful business management systems. Its grid view is compatible with Excel habits while supporting kanban, calendar, Gantt chart, gallery, and other view types. Rich field types support attachments, linked records, formulas, barcodes, and more to meet complex business data modeling needs. Automation features can trigger emails, webhooks, and third-party integrations. Available in free and paid tiers, with paid plans unlocking more records and advanced features. Widely used by companies like Airbnb and Netflix for project tracking, content calendars, and operations management.
linear: Linear is a next-generation project management tool designed specifically for software teams, renowned for its exceptionally smooth user experience and efficient keyboard shortcuts. The clean, elegant interface integrates Issues management, Cycle sprint planning, and Roadmap in one place, letting teams focus on product delivery rather than tool navigation. Deep integration with GitHub and GitLab allows code commits to automatically link and close Issues. Slack notifications and Figma embedding build a complete development collaboration ecosystem. Available in free and paid tiers, it is beloved by top tech companies and startups like Vercel, Notion, and Loom, making it one of the most popular alternatives to Jira.
youtube: YouTube is the world's largest video sharing platform, owned by Google, with over 2.5 billion monthly active users and more than 500 hours of video uploaded every minute. It covers all content categories including tutorials, entertainment, news, music, live streams, and Shorts, making it the world's second-largest search engine. Creators can monetize through ad revenue sharing, Super Thanks, channel memberships, and Super Stickers. YouTube Premium offers ad-free viewing and offline downloads. For content creators, brand marketers, and everyday users alike, YouTube is the irreplaceable platform for consuming and creating video content.
netflix: Netflix is the pioneer and leader of the global streaming industry, with over 260 million paid subscribers across 190+ countries and regions. Netflix's original content production capabilities are formidable, with globally acclaimed hits like House of Cards, Squid Game, and Stranger Things. It supports 4K HDR ultra-high-definition quality with multilingual subtitles and dubbing for global audiences. Personalized recommendation algorithms customize content preferences for each user, with download functionality supporting offline viewing. Available in standard and premium paid plans, it is the preferred streaming platform for series fans and movie enthusiasts.
twitch: Twitch is the world's leading live streaming platform for gaming and creative content, owned by Amazon, with millions of users watching and interacting online daily. The platform centers on game streaming and extends to music, art, outdoor, cooking, and other diverse content categories. Chat, channel points, subscriptions, and Bits virtual currency build a unique interactive economy ecosystem with close streamer-viewer relationships. The annual TwitchCon event is the world's largest live streaming culture festival. Offering free viewing and paid streamer subscription features, it is the core community platform for gamers, esports enthusiasts, and creative streamers.
bilibili: Bilibili (B站) is a comprehensive video platform popular with China's younger generation, starting from anime culture and growing into a diverse content community covering gaming, technology, lifestyle, learning, and music. Its unique bullet comment (danmu) culture makes viewing highly interactive, with an active creator ecosystem producing rich original content. Bilibili's live streaming, interactive video, and article features continue to improve, with educational content particularly popular among college students. Premium membership offers HD quality, ad-free viewing, and exclusive content. With over 300 million monthly active users, it is one of China's most vibrant youth content communities.
tiktok: TikTok is the undisputed leader in global short video platforms, a ByteDance product with over 1 billion monthly active users. Its algorithmic recommendation system precisely captures user interests, delivering highly personalized content feeds that keep users deeply engaged. Short videos ranging from 15 seconds to 10 minutes cover virtually all content categories including comedy, dance, food, education, and fashion. TikTok Shop e-commerce features are rapidly expanding, with live shopping becoming an emerging monetization model. Creator funds and brand partnerships provide multiple monetization pathways, making TikTok the most effective platform for content creators and brands to reach Generation Z.
reddit: Reddit is the world's largest internet community aggregation platform, composed of tens of thousands of niche interest boards (Subreddits) covering virtually every human interest area including tech, gaming, investing, food, and mental health. Users post and comment anonymously, with a voting system determining content visibility to surface quality discussions. Reddit is renowned for authentic user experience sharing and in-depth discussions, with product reviews and industry insights being highly valuable references. The AMA (Ask Me Anything) section enables celebrities and public figures to directly engage with the public. Available free with Reddit Premium paid tier, it is one of the best platforms for obtaining genuine user feedback and deeply understanding niche communities.
hackernews: Hacker News is a tech and startup news aggregation community operated by Y Combinator accelerator, regarded as the information hub for Silicon Valley's elite circles. Users submit links and articles, with community voting determining rankings to ensure high-quality content rises to the top. The comment section features exceptionally high-level technical discussions, aggregating genuine insights from top engineers, founders, and venture capitalists. The Show HN section lets entrepreneurs directly showcase new products to the community, while Ask HN initiates open technical discussions. Completely free with no advertising, it is a daily must-read information source for developers, entrepreneurs, and tech professionals.
producthunt: Product Hunt is the world's largest platform for discovering and reviewing new products, daily featuring and showcasing the latest tech products, apps, and tools. Founders and teams can launch products here, with community users voting and commenting, and popular products gaining massive exposure. It has helped well-known products like Notion, Figma, and ChatGPT acquire large initial user bases in their early stages. For startups, landing on Product Hunt's daily leaderboard is significant brand validation. Offering free browsing and Ship paid tools, it is the must-visit platform for discovering cutting-edge tools, gaining product inspiration, and product launch promotion.
feedly: Feedly is an AI-powered RSS subscription reader that helps users aggregate subscriptions from quality global media, blogs, news sites, and industry information to build personalized information feeds. Its AI assistant Leo automatically filters noise, highlights key content, and generates summaries, dramatically improving information processing efficiency. Supports creating Boards by topic to collect related articles, with seamless integration for Slack, Notion, Evernote, and other tools. Available in free basic and Pro and Teams paid tiers, with Pro unlocking more feeds and AI features. It is an efficient tool for journalists, researchers, content marketers, and information-intensive workers to manage their information flow.
amazon: Amazon is the world's largest e-commerce platform and one of the most comprehensive product catalogs, covering virtually everything from daily necessities and electronics to luxury goods and industrial equipment. Prime membership offers free next-day or same-day delivery, Prime Video streaming, music, and other valuable benefits. Amazon Marketplace allows third-party sellers to join, greatly enriching product categories and competitive pricing. Alexa voice shopping and Subscribe & Save make purchasing more convenient. AWS cloud computing is another core Amazon business supporting countless internet companies worldwide. For both consumers and sellers, Amazon is the central platform of the e-commerce ecosystem.
shopify: Shopify is the world's most popular independent store building platform, enabling entrepreneurs and brands to quickly build professional e-commerce websites and start selling without technical backgrounds. It offers hundreds of beautiful theme templates, complete inventory management, multiple payment methods, and logistics tracking. The Shopify App Store has over 8,000 app extensions covering marketing, SEO, customer service, and more. Supports multi-channel selling across Instagram, TikTok, Amazon, and other platforms. Offering 14-day free trials and monthly paid plans, it currently supports over 1.7 million merchants worldwide, making it the preferred solution for independent e-commerce store building.
etsy: Etsy is the world's largest e-commerce platform for handmade goods, vintage items, and independent creators, connecting millions of artisans, designers, and buyers. Products on the platform are known for their uniqueness and personalization, ranging from handmade jewelry and custom gifts to vintage clothing and digital downloads. Sellers can open shops with low barriers, with Etsy charging small listing fees and transaction commissions. Buyers find one-of-a-kind gifts and support small entrepreneurs here. Etsy Ads help sellers increase product visibility. For artisans, independent designers, and creative product entrepreneurs, Etsy is one of the most accessible platforms for reaching global buyers.
aliexpress: AliExpress is Alibaba Group's cross-border e-commerce platform for global consumers, offering a vast SKU selection at highly competitive prices covering electronics, clothing, home goods, beauty, and virtually every category. The platform aggregates millions of Chinese sellers with shipping to 220+ countries and regions worldwide. Buyer protection plans safeguard consumer rights with complete dispute resolution mechanisms. The AliExpress Choice curated channel offers faster logistics and higher quality products. For global consumers seeking low-cost goods and cross-border e-commerce practitioners, AliExpress is an important procurement channel not to be overlooked.
temu: Temu is PinDuoDuo's overseas e-commerce platform that rapidly swept European and American consumer markets after entering North America in 2022 with an extremely low-price strategy. The platform connects large numbers of Chinese supply chains directly with consumers, eliminating middlemen to achieve ultra-low pricing. Products cover everyday consumer goods including clothing, home goods, electronic accessories, and beauty tools. Temu acquires customers rapidly through social referrals and heavy advertising, consistently topping app store download charts in multiple countries. With comprehensive refund guarantees, it has strong appeal to price-sensitive consumers and has become one of the world's fastest-growing e-commerce platforms.
steam: Steam is the world's largest PC game digital distribution platform, operated by Valve, with over 50,000 games and hundreds of millions of registered users. Users can purchase, download, and manage game libraries, participate in community discussions, workshop creation, and achievement collecting. Steam sales statistics show approximately 75% of global PC game sales are completed through Steam. The twice-yearly Summer and Winter sales are the most anticipated shopping events for gamers, with massive discounts. Steam Workshop allows players to create and share mods. Remote Play Together enables friends to play across devices, making it the central digital home for PC gamers.
epic: Epic Games is the developer of Fortnite and also operates the Epic Games Store PC gaming platform and Unreal Engine. The Epic Store is known for giving away free games weekly, having accumulated free games worth thousands of dollars in total value and attracting massive user registrations. It charges developers only 12% commission, lower than Steam's 30%, attracting many exclusive publishing partnerships. Unreal Engine is one of the world's top game engines, used by AAA titles like Black Myth: Wukong. Offering a free downloadable client, the Epic ecosystem covers the complete chain of game development, publishing, and player community.
roblox: Roblox is a gaming creation and metaverse platform for Generation Z, where users not only play games but can also use Roblox Studio to create and publish their own games and virtual experiences. The platform features over 40 million user-created games with more than 80 million daily active users. The Robux virtual currency builds a complete in-platform economy, enabling top creators to earn substantial income. Roblox has enormous influence among global youth and is often viewed as the next generation of internet social and entertainment gateway. Offering free downloads and Roblox Premium subscriptions, it is an important platform for young people to explore creative programming and game design.
itch: itch.io is the world's largest independent game publishing and discovery platform, aggregating hundreds of thousands of games, tools, and creative works by independent developers. The platform is extremely developer-friendly, allowing custom revenue split ratios where developers can even set 0% platform commission. Players can support favorite developers with pay-what-you-want pricing, with many games offering free play. Annual Game Jam events encourage developers to create games within time limits, serving as an important channel for discovering indie game stars. For indie game enthusiasts and developers alike, itch.io is a vibrant independent creative ecosystem community.
chess: Chess.com is the world's largest online chess platform with over 150 million registered users, offering online matches, puzzle training, lessons, and live event streaming. The platform's AI analysis engine performs deep game reviews, precisely identifying mistakes and suggesting optimal moves. Daily puzzles sharpen chess intuition, with learning paths systematically covering beginner to grandmaster level. Supports real-time matches against humans or AI opponents at various difficulty levels, with a comprehensive competitive rating system. Tournament and league features are also available, with world-class players like Magnus Carlsen active on the platform. Available in free and Diamond paid membership tiers.
coursera: Coursera is a leading global online education platform partnering with 300+ top universities and companies including Stanford, Yale, Google, and IBM to offer professional certificates, bachelor's and master's degree programs. Learners can study popular fields like data science, AI, business management, and programming, with courses recorded by top professors and industry experts ensuring quality. Completing courses earns professional certificates widely recognized by employers. Offers both free course auditing and paid subscription models, with Coursera Plus providing unlimited access to 7,000+ courses. It is an important learning platform for professionals seeking career transitions and competitive skill upgrades.
udemy: Udemy is the world's largest online course marketplace, aggregating over 210,000 courses and 70,000 instructors covering virtually every learning area including programming, design, marketing, personal development, and music. Courses are created by independent instructors at affordable prices, with frequent sales often reducing courses originally priced in the hundreds to just a few dollars. One-time purchases provide permanent access without subscription pressure. Udemy for Business offers team training solutions for enterprises. Whether learning Python programming, UI design, or guitar playing, high-rated quality courses can be found on Udemy. It is one of the highest value-for-money skill learning platforms available.
duolingo: Duolingo is the world's most popular language learning app, using gamification design to make language learning fun and sustainable. Offering 40+ language courses including English, Spanish, French, Japanese, and Chinese, daily minutes of practice uses points, streaks, and leaderboards to motivate continuous learning. Duolingo research shows its courses can rival university language programs in effectiveness. Offers completely free core features and Duolingo Super paid tier (ad-free, unlimited lives). With over 80 million monthly active users, it is the preferred introductory tool for global language learners.
khanacademy: Khan Academy is a nonprofit free online education platform founded by Sal Khan with the mission of providing free world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Covering K-12 and college prep courses in math, science, history, economics, and programming through video explanations, exercises, and instant feedback building a complete learning system. The Khanmigo AI tutoring assistant provides personalized learning guidance. The platform is completely free and has helped over 150 million students learn worldwide. Adopted by many US schools as supplementary teaching resources, particularly effective for math foundation building and SAT preparation. It is an important force driving educational equity globally.
brilliant: Brilliant is a STEM learning platform centered on interactive problem-solving, focused on deep learning in mathematics, science, computer science, and data analysis. Unlike traditional video courses, Brilliant guides learners through carefully designed interactive problems to actively think and derive conclusions, genuinely understanding principles rather than memorizing. Courses range from basic algebra to advanced topics like calculus, quantum mechanics, and machine learning. Available with free trial and annual paid subscription unlocking all courses. Suitable for students, engineers, and lifelong learners interested in STEM, it is a quality platform for developing deep thinking capabilities.
coinbase: Coinbase is America's largest and most compliant cryptocurrency exchange, listed on NASDAQ and known for security and regulatory compliance. Supporting hundreds of cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin and Ethereum for buying, selling, storing, and transferring, with a user-friendly interface suitable for beginners. Coinbase Pro (now Advanced Trade) provides professional trading charts and lower fees. Coinbase Wallet supports DeFi and NFT operations. The Learn & Earn feature rewards small cryptocurrency amounts for completing educational content. Offering free registration and transaction-based fees, it is the preferred compliant platform for North American crypto investors and a trusted custodial service provider for institutional investors.
tradingview: TradingView is the world's most popular financial charting and trading analysis platform with over 50 million users, covering stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, futures, and all financial market data. Its powerful technical analysis tools support hundreds of indicators and drawing tools, with Pine Script custom scripting enabling users to develop proprietary strategies. Social features allow sharing chart analyses and trading ideas, with top analyst insights available for learning. Supports direct broker connections for placing trades. Available in free basic and Pro, Pro+, Premium paid tiers, it is an indispensable market analysis tool for retail investors, traders, and analysts.
robinhood: Robinhood is America's most disruptive zero-commission stock and cryptocurrency trading platform, breaking traditional brokerage high barriers with an ultra-simple interface and zero fees, enabling ordinary young people to easily participate in stock market investing. Supports stocks, ETFs, options, and cryptocurrency trading, with Robinhood Gold paid membership offering margin lending and advanced research reports. Instant deposit features eliminate waiting for funds to clear. The 2021 GameStop event made it a global focus while also sparking regulatory controversy. Currently with tens of millions of active US users, it is an important force driving the democratization of retail investing in America.
bloomberg: Bloomberg is the world's most authoritative financial data and media conglomerate. Bloomberg.com offers some free financial news, while Bloomberg Markets and Bloomberg Technology are industry information benchmarks. wise: Wise (formerly TransferWise) is a leading global cross-border remittance and multi-currency account service platform, known for transparent low fees and real exchange rates, averaging 4-8x savings compared to traditional banks. bitwarden: Bitwarden is a leading open-source password manager trusted by millions of users for its transparent open-source code, strong security, and cross-platform support. Supporting unlimited device sync, password generator, secure notes, and file storage with all data end-to-end encrypted so even Bitwarden's servers cannot access user passwords. nordvpn: NordVPN is one of the world's most well-known VPN providers, with over 6,000 servers in 60+ countries offering fast and stable encrypted network connections. Using military-grade AES-256 encryption with a strict no-logs policy verified through multiple independent security audits. The NordLynx protocol based on WireGuard provides ultra-fast connections, while double VPN and obfuscated servers further enhance privacy protection. Supports simultaneous connections on 6 devices, compatible with all major platforms. Threat Protection blocks malware and trackers. Offering monthly and annual subscription plans with annual pricing being more competitive, it is a popular choice for users prioritizing network privacy and security.
cloudflare: Cloudflare is the world's largest network security and performance optimization service provider, with its network connected to over 20% of websites globally. Cloudflare Workers serverless computing platform enables developers to deploy code on the edge network. The 1.1.1.1 public DNS service is renowned for speed and privacy protection. The free tier already meets most personal and small website needs, with paid tiers offering more advanced security and performance features for enterprises. 1password: 1Password is a professional password management solution for individuals, families, and enterprises, known for excellent user experience and powerful team features. Team versions support tiered permission management and secure sharing, highly favored by tech companies and enterprise teams. Offering 14-day free trials with individual and family annual subscriptions, it is one of the most complete commercial password managers available.
protonmail: Proton Mail is an end-to-end encrypted email service from Switzerland, founded by CERN scientists and known for extreme privacy protection and security. Headquartered in Switzerland under strict data protection laws, unaffected by US PRISM surveillance programs. Offering free basic accounts and Proton Mail Plus paid tier, with paid plans unlocking custom domains, larger storage, and advanced filtering rules. Together with Proton VPN, Proton Drive, and Proton Calendar, it forms a complete privacy-focused digital life suite.
expressvpn: ExpressVPN is one of the world's most trusted VPN providers, renowned for ultra-fast connection speeds, stability, and powerful penetration capabilities in restrictive network environments. With 3,000+ servers in 94 countries using the proprietary Lightway protocol for optimal speed-security balance. Strict no-logs policy verified through independent audits, with RAM-only server architecture ensuring data is never permanently stored. Supports simultaneous connections on 5 devices, compatible with all major platforms and routers. Offering monthly and annual subscriptions with 30-day money-back guarantee. It is one of the most reliable VPN choices in regions with strict internet censorship.
surfshark: Surfshark is an exceptionally high value-for-money VPN provider, with its standout feature being unlimited simultaneous device connections, covering all family devices with one account. With 3,200+ servers in 100+ countries using WireGuard and IKEv2 protocols for fast, stable connections. CleanWeb feature blocks ads, malware, and trackers, while Camouflage Mode makes VPN traffic difficult to identify. MultiHop double-hop feature routes traffic through two servers for enhanced anonymity. Surfshark One package additionally includes antivirus software and data breach monitoring. Annual subscription pricing is highly competitive, making it the ideal choice for family users and multi-device users.
signal: Signal is the world's most recognized secure instant messaging app, developed by the nonprofit Signal Foundation, with all communications protected by open-source end-to-end encryption protocols. Collects no user metadata, with servers unable to access any chat content, contacts, or call records. Supports text, voice, video calls, group chats, and file sharing, with disappearing messages enabling automatic deletion. Publicly recommended by privacy advocates including Edward Snowden and Elon Musk. Completely free with no advertising and no data collection, it is the preferred communication tool for users with the highest privacy and security requirements.
virustotal: VirusTotal is Google's free online malware scanning service that allows users to upload files, URLs, IP addresses, or domain names for simultaneous scanning analysis using 70+ antivirus engines and security tools. Detailed scan results display each engine's detection conclusions, helping users assess the safety of files or links. Security researchers use it to cross-validate threat intelligence, while ordinary users perform safety checks before downloading unfamiliar files. VirusTotal Intelligence provides advanced threat analysis features for enterprises and professional security teams. Completely free to use, it is one of the most practical online tools in cybersecurity, processing millions of scan requests daily.
haveibeenpwned: Have I Been Pwned is a free data breach lookup service created by security researcher Troy Hunt, where users enter an email or phone number to instantly check if it has appeared in known data breach incidents. The database contains billions of records from hundreds of major data breaches including leaks from large platforms like Adobe, LinkedIn, and Dropbox. The Pwned Passwords feature checks whether commonly used passwords have been compromised, alerting users to change them promptly. Supports free email notification subscriptions that alert immediately when an email appears in new breach events. Integrated by major browsers and password managers worldwide, it is a first-line defense tool for protecting personal network security.
brave: Brave is a privacy-first browser built on the Chromium engine that blocks ads and trackers by default, loading pages 3-6x faster than Chrome while significantly reducing data consumption. Built-in VPN, Tor private windows, and fingerprint tracking prevention provide comprehensive privacy protection. The Brave Rewards system allows users to opt into privacy-respecting ads and earn BAT cryptocurrency rewards, reconstructing the digital advertising ecosystem. Brave Search is an independent search engine that doesn't rely on Google's index. Compatible with all Chrome extensions with extremely low migration costs. Completely free to download and use, it is one of the best alternatives to Chrome for privacy-conscious users.
protonvpn: Proton VPN is the VPN service under Proton, sharing the same privacy philosophy and Swiss legal protection as Proton Mail. Offers a strict no-logs policy with all servers verified through independent security audits. Secure Core feature routes traffic through multiple servers for double protection, while NetShield blocks ads and malware. The standout feature is a truly complete permanent free tier — free users can access servers in 3 countries with no data limits. Paid tiers unlock more countries, faster speeds, and advanced security features. One of the most trusted VPN services in the privacy community with deep integration into the Proton ecosystem.
gemini: Gemini is a multimodal AI model developed by Google DeepMind and the core engine powering Google's AI assistant products. Three versions — Ultra, Pro, and Nano — target high-end research, everyday use, and mobile scenarios respectively. Deeply integrated into Google Search, Gmail, Google Docs, and other products, providing ubiquitous AI assistance. Gemini 1.5 Pro supports up to 1 million token ultra-long contexts, handling very long videos, codebases, and documents. Google AI Studio provides free API access for developer testing. One of ChatGPT's strongest competitors, backed by Google's powerful search data and infrastructure advantages.
copilot: Microsoft Copilot is Microsoft's AI assistant deeply integrated into Windows 11, Microsoft 365 office suite, and Bing search, providing seamless AI assistance to billions of users. In Word it auto-drafts documents, in Excel it analyzes data, in PowerPoint it generates presentations, and in Teams it automatically organizes meeting notes. Copilot is built on GPT-4 and DALL-E with connected internet search capabilities. The free tier is available through Bing and Windows, with Microsoft 365 Copilot paid tier targeting enterprise users. It is Microsoft's most important strategic product for integrating AI into everyday office workflows.
wenxin: Wenxin Yiyan (ERNIE Bot) is Baidu's large language model and AI conversation product, built on the ERNIE 4.0 model with outstanding performance in Chinese comprehension, content creation, and knowledge Q&A. Deeply integrated with Baidu Search, Maps, and Netdisk ecosystems, enabling real-time internet information retrieval. tongyi: Tongyi Qianwen is Alibaba Cloud's large language model product built on proprietary Tongyi models, excelling in multilingual understanding, code generation, and logical reasoning. doubao: Doubao is ByteDance's AI conversation assistant, powered by the proprietary Skylark large model, delivering smooth and natural experiences in content creation, information search, and daily conversation. kimi: Kimi is an AI assistant launched by Moonshot AI, renowned for its exceptional ultra-long context processing capabilities, supporting one-time upload and analysis of extremely long documents, PDFs, web pages, and other content. zhipu: Zhipu AI is an AI company founded by a Tsinghua University technical team, with its GLM series large models and ChatGLM conversation products having broad influence in both academic and industrial circles. elevenlabs: ElevenLabs is the world's leading AI voice synthesis platform, renowned for its incredibly realistic voice cloning and text-to-speech technology. heygen: HeyGen is a leading AI video generation platform focused on rapidly converting text scripts into professional videos featuring realistic digital human presenters. pika: Pika is a next-generation AI video generation platform known for its extremely low barrier to entry and excellent creative video effects. adobe-firefly: Adobe Firefly is Adobe's generative AI creative tool suite, deeply integrated into Adobe's full product family including Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro, enabling professional designers to use AI capabilities directly within familiar workflows. dribbble: Dribbble is the world's premier design portfolio showcase and professional social platform, renowned for beautiful UI designs, brand visuals, and illustrations, aggregating the world's most talented design professionals. unsplash: Unsplash is the world's most popular free high-quality photo resource platform, aggregating over 3 million professional photography works contributed by photographers, all freely usable for commercial and personal projects without attribution required. iconify: Iconify is the most comprehensive open-source icon framework, integrating 200,000+ icons from over 200 popular icon sets including Material Icons, Font Awesome, Heroicons, and Tabler Icons, all accessible through a unified API. lottiefiles: LottieFiles is the largest community platform based on the Lottie animation format. removebg: Remove.bg is the world's most well-known AI one-click background removal tool, with industry-leading accuracy that precisely identifies subjects like people, animals, and products to perfectly separate them from backgrounds, fully automated without manual operation. mastergo: MasterGo is China's leading professional UI/UX design collaboration tool, functionally comparable to Figma and optimized for Chinese designers and teams with improved collaboration experience and domestic access speeds. pexels: Pexels is a high-quality royalty-free photo and video resource platform where all content is voluntarily contributed by photographers and videographers, completely free for commercial and personal projects with no registration required for downloads. gitlab: GitLab is the most complete all-in-one DevOps platform, integrating code hosting, CI/CD pipelines, project management, security scanning, and monitoring into a single platform, providing a complete toolchain from code submission to production deployment. supabase: Supabase is an open-source Firebase alternative built on PostgreSQL, providing developers with backend infrastructure services including database, authentication, file storage, edge functions, and real-time subscriptions. netlify: Netlify is a static website and Jamstack application hosting platform designed specifically for frontend developers, renowned for its ultra-simple deployment experience and powerful edge network. railway: Railway is a next-generation cloud application deployment platform that enables developers to deploy applications in any language within minutes without complex server configuration. docker: Docker is the core infrastructure of modern software development and deployment, using containerization technology to package applications and all their dependencies into portable container images, achieving build once, run anywhere. npm: npm (Node Package Manager) is the world's largest software package registry and core infrastructure of the JavaScript ecosystem, with over 2 million open-source packages and more than 30 billion weekly downloads. Competing with Yarn and pnpm, collectively advancing JavaScript package management standards.
regex101: Regex101 is the most powerful online regular expression testing and debugging tool, supporting multiple regex engines including PCRE, Python, JavaScript, and Golang, providing real-time highlighted match results and detailed step-by-step explanations. devdocs: DevDocs is a free offline API documentation aggregation tool essential for developers, consolidating official documentation for 300+ programming languages and frameworks into a unified interface with fast full-text search and offline access. Supports custom selection of needed documentation collections, saving significant storage space. caniuse: Can I Use is the authoritative browser compatibility reference tool for frontend developers, providing up-to-date support data for HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript APIs across major browser versions, covering Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and all platform browsers. zoom: Zoom is the world's most widely used video conferencing platform, becoming synonymous with remote work during its explosive pandemic-era growth, now hosting over 300 million meeting minutes daily. feishu: Feishu (Lark) is ByteDance's next-generation enterprise collaboration platform, integrating instant messaging, video conferencing, online documents, cloud storage, calendar, and project management into a complete work operating system centered on connecting people and information. prisma: Prisma is the most popular next-generation ORM (Object-Relational Mapping) tool in the Node.js and TypeScript ecosystem, fundamentally simplifying database operation complexity through intuitive data model definitions and type-safe query APIs. Prisma Schema uses declarative syntax to define data models and automatically generates TypeScript type definitions, enabling database query errors to be caught at compile time. Supports mainstream databases including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, and SQL Server, with Prisma Migrate managing database migration history. Prisma Studio provides a visual database management interface. Seamlessly integrated with Next.js, Remix, NestJS, and other mainstream frameworks, it is the preferred database tool for full-stack TypeScript projects. Completely free and open-source, with Prisma Data Platform providing cloud-based data management features, it is an important component of modern full-stack development workflows.
planetscale: PlanetScale is a cloud database platform built on Vitess (the MySQL scaling technology used by YouTube and Slack), known for the concept of managing databases like code, enabling database Schema changes to be safely managed like Git branches through the Branches feature. Non-blocking Schema change technology allows modifying database structures without downtime, completely solving the downtime risk of traditional MySQL migrations. Automatic horizontal sharding provides virtually unlimited scaling capacity to support massive-scale traffic. Works perfectly with Prisma and Drizzle ORM. Offering a free Hobby plan and paid production plans, it is the ideal database choice for modern web applications seeking MySQL compatibility while needing massive scaling capabilities.
mongodb: MongoDB is the world's most popular NoSQL database, known for its flexible document-based data model (JSON format) and powerful query capabilities, solving the limitations of relational databases when handling complex nested data and rapidly iterating requirements. The document model naturally suits storing product catalogs, user profiles, content management, and other variably structured data. Atlas cloud database service provides fully managed MongoDB clusters supporting global multi-region deployment and auto-scaling. Atlas Search provides Lucene-based full-text search, while Atlas Vector Search supports AI vector retrieval scenarios. Time-series data support and aggregation pipelines meet complex data analysis needs. Offering a free M0 cluster (512MB) and paid production plans, it is the standard database in Node.js ecosystems and MEAN/MERN technology stacks.
redis: Redis is the world's most popular in-memory database and caching solution, known for extremely low read/write latency (microsecond level) and rich data structures (strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, streams, and more). As a cache layer it dramatically reduces database pressure, as a message queue it enables async processing, and as session storage it supports distributed systems. Pub/Sub supports real-time message publishing and subscription, with Lua scripts supporting atomic operations. Redis Stack introduces JSON, time-series, and vector similarity search extensions. Redis Cloud provides fully managed cloud service. Virtually all mainstream programming languages have mature Redis client libraries. Core infrastructure of high-traffic sites including Twitter, GitHub, and Stack Overflow uses Redis, making it an indispensable component of modern high-performance application architecture.
elasticsearch: Elasticsearch is a distributed full-text search and analytics engine based on Lucene, the industry standard tool for log analysis, full-text retrieval, and real-time data analysis scenarios. RESTful API design makes indexing and querying simple and intuitive, with powerful aggregation capabilities supporting complex data statistical analysis. Combined with Kibana (visualization), Logstash (data pipeline), and Beats (data collection) to form the ELK Stack, the mainstream solution for enterprise-grade log management and monitoring. Elasticsearch Service (Elastic Cloud) provides fully managed cloud service. Widely deployed by well-known enterprises including GitHub, Netflix, and Wikipedia to support search and log analysis infrastructure. Offering open-source versions and Elastic Cloud paid service, it is the core technology choice for enterprises needing large-scale full-text search and real-time analysis capabilities.
grafana: Grafana is the most popular open-source observability and data visualization platform, supporting connections to dozens of data sources including Prometheus, InfluxDB, Elasticsearch, MySQL, and AWS CloudWatch to create beautiful real-time monitoring dashboards. The drag-and-drop panel editor supports multiple visualization types including line charts, bar charts, heatmaps, and maps, with alert features automatically notifying on metric anomalies. Grafana Loki is a lightweight log aggregation system, Grafana Tempo provides distributed tracing, together with Prometheus forming the complete three pillars of observability (Metrics, Logs, Traces). Grafana Cloud provides fully managed cloud service with a generous free tier. Used by millions of developers and DevOps teams worldwide to monitor system health, it is a core tool for DevOps and SRE teams.
datadog: Datadog is the most enterprise-favored full-stack monitoring and observability SaaS platform in the cloud-native era, providing integrated infrastructure monitoring, APM (Application Performance Management), log management, Real User Monitoring (RUM), and security detection. The Agent automatically discovers and collects metrics, logs, and trace data from virtually all cloud services and applications, with 600+ integrations covering mainstream technology stacks. Smart alerting reduces false positives, with AI-assisted root cause analysis accelerating troubleshooting. Adopted by global top enterprises including Airbnb, Samsung, and Comcast, it is the standard monitoring tool for DevOps and SRE teams. Offering 14-day free trials and per-host paid plans, it is the preferred platform for large enterprises and fast-growing tech companies building observability systems.
sentry: Sentry is the most commonly used application error tracking and performance monitoring platform for developers, automatically capturing crashes, exceptions, and performance issues in applications, providing detailed error context (stack traces, user information, request data) to help developers quickly locate and fix problems. Supports 100+ programming languages and frameworks including JavaScript, Python, Java, and React Native, with extremely simple integration typically requiring only a few lines of code. Session Replay records user actions to reproduce error scenarios, while the Performance module tracks Web Vitals and custom transactions. GitHub integration supports linking directly from Issues to related code commits. Offering a generous free tier (10,000 errors/month) and paid tiers, it is an essential monitoring tool for every development team that takes code quality seriously.
pagerduty: PagerDuty is an enterprise-grade alert management and incident response platform that helps DevOps and SRE teams quickly sense, coordinate, and resolve system failures to minimize Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR). Integrates with hundreds of monitoring tools including Datadog, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, and Splunk to automatically route alerts to the right on-call personnel. Smart alert merging reduces alert fatigue, scheduling management ensures 24/7 coverage, and Postmortem features help teams review and summarize incidents. PagerDuty AIOps uses machine learning to automatically classify and correlate alerts. Offering free trials and per-user paid plans, widely adopted by global enterprises including IBM, GE, and Netflix, it is a core operations tool for ensuring critical business system availability.
newrelic: New Relic is a full-stack observability platform providing an integrated solution combining APM, infrastructure monitoring, browser monitoring, mobile monitoring, log management, and distributed tracing, giving engineering teams a clear view of the health of their entire technology stack. Its unified data platform (NRDB) stores all telemetry data (metrics, events, logs, traces) in one place, with cross-data-type correlation analysis being extremely powerful. AI-assisted anomaly detection and root cause analysis accelerates incident response. New Relic announced in 2023 that core features would be free forever, providing 100GB/month of free data ingestion, dramatically lowering the usage barrier for small and medium teams. Deeply integrated with AWS, Azure, and GCP, it is an important tool for cloud-native application monitoring and fault diagnosis.
anthropic: Anthropic is an American artificial intelligence company dedicated to AI safety research, founded by former OpenAI research team members, and the developer of the Claude series of models. Known for safety technologies like Constitutional AI, dedicated to building reliable, interpretable, and controllable AI systems. The Claude API lets developers integrate Claude's powerful capabilities into their own products, supporting different performance and price tier models including Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Claude Haiku. 100K token ultra-long context processing is a core competitive advantage. Particularly outstanding in long-text analysis, code generation, and safe content filtering. Offering token-based billing for API access and the Claude.ai conversation product, with Amazon (AWS Bedrock) as an important partner. It is OpenAI's most important safety-oriented competitor, deeply trusted by enterprises and safety-conscious developers.
cohere: Cohere is an AI company focused on enterprise NLP applications, providing core AI API services for text generation, semantic embedding, and retrieval, known for enterprise-grade reliability and security compliance. The Command series models are optimized for commercial text generation scenarios, while Embed models excel at semantic similarity search, an efficient choice for building semantic search and RAG systems. Rerank models significantly improve RAG application answer quality through re-ranking retrieval results. Coral is Cohere's enterprise knowledge Q&A product that accesses enterprise private data in secure environments. Supports private cloud and on-premises deployment for industries like finance and healthcare with strict data sovereignty requirements. Offering free API trial credits and enterprise paid plans, it is an important choice for AI API providers prioritizing enterprise security compliance, with deep partnerships with Salesforce and Oracle.
mistral: Mistral AI is a French AI startup known for efficient open-source language models, with Mistral 7B and Mixtral 8x7B models achieving performance far exceeding other models of similar parameter size, drawing widespread industry attention. Mixtral uses a Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (Sparse MoE) architecture that dramatically improves model capabilities while maintaining inference speed, becoming one of the highest value-for-money choices among open-source models. Mistral Large and Mistral Medium are closed-source commercial models available through paid API access. Le Chat is Mistral's conversation product. Open-source models can be freely downloaded from Hugging Face, with API services billed per token. As one of Europe's most important AI companies, Mistral's influence in the open-source AI ecosystem continues to rise, making it one of the preferred choices for developers seeking efficient lightweight open-source models.
ollama: Ollama is the most popular local LLM running tool, enabling developers to run hundreds of open-source large language models including Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, and Qwen on Mac, Windows, and Linux with a single command, without cloud API, running completely locally to protect data privacy. Provides a locally hosted OpenAI API-compatible interface, making it easy to quickly migrate existing OpenAI-based applications to local models. GPU acceleration (supporting NVIDIA CUDA and Apple Metal) dramatically improves inference speed. The Ollama model library is continuously updated, usually supporting new models immediately upon release. Completely free and open-source with over 90,000 GitHub Stars, it has become the standard tool for local AI developers. For developers who prioritize privacy, want to use AI assistants offline, or don't want to pay API fees, Ollama is the simplest local LLM solution.
lmstudio: LM Studio is the most complete local LLM desktop application, providing a ChatGPT-like chat interface and model management features that make it easy for ordinary users to run and test various open-source large language models locally. Built-in model search and download functionality lets users browse and download quantized models (GGUF format) directly from Hugging Face. Local server functionality provides an OpenAI API-compatible interface, making it easy for developers to use LM Studio for local development testing. Supports GPU acceleration (NVIDIA, AMD, and Apple Silicon). Model comparison features support simultaneously testing outputs from multiple models. Completely free, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux, it is a quality tool for developers and AI enthusiasts for local model evaluation, privacy-sensitive conversations, and offline AI use, with a more user-friendly interface than Ollama.
jan: Jan is a completely open-source local AI assistant desktop application, operating under the philosophy of your computer, your AI, providing a fully offline AI conversation experience where all data stays local and is never uploaded to the cloud. Supports running mainstream open-source models including Llama, Mistral, and Gemma, with a model store for one-click download and installation. Provides a ChatGPT-like conversation interface with support for multiple conversation histories and custom system prompts. Built-in local API server compatible with OpenAI API format for easy third-party application integration. Supports multi-GPU and CPU inference for different hardware configurations. Similar to LM Studio but with greater focus on open-source and privacy, completely free and open-source (AGPL license), it is one of the most popular local AI assistant applications for users who value data sovereignty, receiving substantial attention in privacy-conscious technical communities.
open-webui: Open WebUI (formerly Ollama WebUI) is the most popular open-source AI chat interface, providing a ChatGPT-like web conversation experience that can connect to Ollama local models or OpenAI API, supporting unified management of both local and cloud models. Supports multiple users, conversation history, Markdown rendering, code highlighting, and file uploads for an experience close to ChatGPT Plus. RAG features support uploading documents for document-based Q&A, with Web Search supporting internet-enhanced responses. One-click Docker deployment enables a complete local AI chat service within minutes. Completely free and open-source (MIT license) with over 50,000 GitHub Stars, the most feature-complete choice among self-hosted AI chat interfaces, deeply welcomed by users who want to deploy private AI assistants on home or enterprise intranets.
together-ai: Together AI is a cloud platform focused on high-speed AI inference and open-source model API services, providing fast API access to dozens of top open-source models including Llama, Mistral, Qwen, and Falcon with industry-leading inference speeds (up to 200+ tokens per second). Provides an OpenAI API format-compatible interface with extremely low migration costs. API pricing for top open-source models like Llama 3 is much lower than OpenAI, suitable for cost-sensitive AI applications. Together Fine-tuning supports custom fine-tuning of open-source models and deploying them as APIs. Serverless inference eliminates infrastructure management. Offering a free trial quota with subsequent token-based billing. An ideal choice for developers and enterprises wanting high-performance open-source model API capabilities at low cost, particularly suitable for high-throughput application scenarios.
groq: Groq is an AI acceleration company with ultra-fast AI inference as its core competitive advantage, with its proprietary LPU (Language Processing Unit) chips achieving currently the fastest LLM inference speeds in the industry (up to 500-800 tokens per second), several times faster than NVIDIA GPU inference. Provides ultra-fast inference services for mainstream open-source models including Llama, Mixtral, and Gemma through the GroqCloud API, with extremely low latency and nearly instant responses. Compatible with OpenAI API format with zero migration cost. The free tier provides a generous limited daily API call quota, attracting many developers to try it. Paid plans target high-concurrency production applications. For developers needing real-time conversation experiences, streaming output, and low-latency AI applications, Groq is currently the fastest API choice for inference, generating enormous attention and enthusiasm in the AI developer community.
stable-diffusion: Stable Diffusion is an open-source text-to-image diffusion model by Stability AI that has become one of the most impactful technologies in AI image generation thanks to being completely open-source and free. Users can deploy and run it locally, with complete control over the image generation process, no content restrictions, and no usage fees. The latest versions SDXL and SD 3 have significantly improved image quality and text rendering. The massive community ecosystem provides tens of thousands of LoRA fine-tuned models, ControlNet control tools, various Checkpoints, and plugins. Civitai is the largest SD model sharing community. AUTOMATIC1111 and ComfyUI are the most popular local interfaces. For professional users, game artists, and researchers who want complete control over the AI image generation process, Stable Diffusion is the most important AI image generation choice alongside Midjourney.
comfyui: ComfyUI is a Stable Diffusion interface based on node graph workflows, known for extreme flexibility and powerful workflow customization capabilities, the preferred tool for professional AI image generation users. Complex image generation pipelines are built by connecting different nodes, supporting various models including Stable Diffusion, SDXL, SD 3, and Flux. Precisely controls every parameter of the generation process, supporting advanced features like multi-model chaining, ControlNet precise control, and IP Adapter style transfer. Node-based workflows can be saved and shared, with the community providing large numbers of ready-made workflow templates. The Comfy Manager plugin manager simplifies model and plugin installation. Completely free and open-source, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux, requiring a capable GPU for smooth operation, it is an indispensable production tool for professional AI visual creators.
automatic1111: AUTOMATIC1111 (A1111) is the most popular Stable Diffusion local Web UI, becoming the preferred interface for local SD users with its rich features, large plugin ecosystem, and relatively friendly interface. Provides a complete suite of image processing features including text-to-image (txt2img), image-to-image (img2img), inpainting, and super-resolution upscaling. The Extensions ecosystem provides hundreds of feature extensions including important tools like ControlNet, AnimateDiff, and ADetailer. Prompt history and parameter comparison features facilitate systematic testing and optimization of generation results. Supports xFormers acceleration and multiple samplers. Completely free and open-source with relatively high configuration requirements (NVIDIA GPU recommended), it is the go-to starting point for local Stable Diffusion deployment, with one of the world's largest SD user communities.
leonardo: Leonardo.Ai is an AI image generation platform for game artists and creative professionals, providing more professional control features than Midjourney. Its trained proprietary models are particularly good at generating images in game concept art, character design, scene illustration, and game asset styles. Image Guidance features support precise control of composition and style, while AI Canvas provides creative image editing tools. Model training features allow users to upload reference images to train custom style models. Offers daily free token quotas with paid subscriptions unlocking more generation credits and advanced features. Highly regarded in game developer, concept artist, and digital illustrator communities, it is one of Midjourney's most important competitors in professional game and film/TV art domains, standing out for greater controllability and professional toolsets.
ideogram: Ideogram is an image generation platform focused on solving the text rendering problem in AI image generation, with its main distinguishing feature being the ability to accurately render clear and readable text within images, solving the long-standing poor text generation quality problem of tools like Midjourney and Stable Diffusion. Suitable for generating posters, logos, banner ads, and brand visual designs containing text. Ideogram 2.0 has also significantly improved overall image quality, supporting multiple image styles (realistic, illustration, 3D, etc.). The Magic Fill feature supports local content filling and modification of images. Offering daily free generation credits and subscription paid tiers, it has rapidly accumulated a large user base among designers, marketers, and content creators who need AI-generated images containing text, making it the most specialized AI image tool for this scenario.
adobe-express: Adobe Express is Adobe's lightweight design tool for the general public, offering simplified design features as a direct competitor to Canva. Built-in thousands of professional templates covering social media graphics, posters, flyers, and video design needs with one-click templates for quick completion. Deep integration with Adobe Creative Cloud enables direct access to Adobe Stock's vast image library. Generative AI features (based on Adobe Firefly) support AI image and background generation. Free for Creative Cloud subscribers, with the standalone version offering limited free features and a paid premium tier.
