It is the core tool every website operator and digital marketer must master.
semrush: SEMrush is the all-in-one online marketing toolkit trusted by professional SEO practitioners and digital marketing teams worldwide, providing comprehensive features including keyword research, competitor analysis, website auditing, backlink tracking, and content marketing. The Keyword Magic Tool has over 25 billion keywords to help discover long-tail traffic opportunities. Domain comparison analysis gives users a clear picture of the gap versus competitors. Website technical audit identifies SEO ranking issues and provides fix recommendations. Paid advertising research tools analyze competitor Google Ads strategies. Offering 7-day free trials and Pro, Guru, Business subscription plans, it is an indispensable professional platform for SEO practitioners, content marketing teams, and digital agencies.
ahrefs: Ahrefs is a top-tier global SEO tool suite, renowned for its industry's most powerful backlink database (over 300 billion links) and precise keyword ranking tracking. Site Explorer deeply analyzes organic traffic, paid traffic, and backlinks for any website; Keywords Explorer provides keyword difficulty scores and traffic forecasts; Content Explorer discovers high-viral content for any topic. The website audit tool scans technical SEO issues, while Rank Tracker continuously monitors target keyword ranking changes. High crawl frequency keeps data freshness industry-leading. Offering monthly paid subscription plans, it is the preferred tool for professional SEO practitioners and content marketing teams with the highest data accuracy requirements.
buffer: Buffer is a social media management and content publishing scheduling tool that helps individual creators and brand teams efficiently manage content publishing plans across multiple social accounts. Supports major platforms including Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Pinterest, allowing batch scheduling in advance with the system automatically publishing at optimal times. Content calendars provide an intuitive overview of publishing plans, with queue features maintaining consistent content rhythm. Analytics track performance data for each post to help optimize content strategy. Offering a free tier (3 social accounts) and Essentials, Team, Agency paid plans, it is a convenient tool for content creators, small businesses, and social media managers to improve publishing efficiency.
hootsuite: Hootsuite is an enterprise-grade social media management platform supporting unified dashboard management of content publishing, monitoring, engagement, and analytics across 35+ social network accounts. Content calendars, bulk scheduled publishing, team collaboration approval workflows, and ROI analytics reports build a complete enterprise social media operations system. Social listening features track brand mentions, competitor activities, and industry topics in real-time. Integrates with creative tools like Canva and Adobe as well as CRM platforms like Salesforce and HubSpot. Offering 30-day free trials and Professional, Team, Business, Enterprise subscription plans, it is the core platform for large brands, agencies, and multinational corporations managing social media matrices.
adobe-premiere: Adobe Premiere Pro is the standard editing software for Hollywood professional film and television production, widely used by the world's top film directors, television production companies, and video creators. Supports lossless editing across all resolutions including 4K, 8K, and VR, with powerful and flexible timeline editing. Deep integration with After Effects, Audition, Photoshop, and other Adobe suite products builds professional post-production workflows. The Lumetri Color panel provides professional-grade color grading, while Premiere Speech to Text automatically generates captions. Adobe Sensei AI technology accelerates editing workflows, including auto-reframe sequences and scene edit detection. Available as part of a Creative Cloud subscription, it is an essential tool for video professionals and those learning video production.
davinci: DaVinci Resolve is Blackmagic Design's full-featured video production software, renowned for industry-leading color grading capabilities while integrating editing, visual effects, motion graphics, and Fairlight audio post-production in one platform. Its free version is already extremely powerful, rivaling many paid professional software products on the market, with the Studio paid version unlocking neural network AI processing, collaboration features, and more effects. Widely adopted by top Hollywood colorists and many independent filmmakers, with acclaimed productions like Game of Thrones and Avengers using it for color grading. Collaboration features support multiple people working simultaneously on the same project for professional production teams. It is the most cost-effective professional tool for video creators from editing to final output.
capcut: CapCut is ByteDance's cross-platform short video editing tool that rapidly became the preferred editor for global short video creators through its simple operation and powerful AI features. Built-in massive templates, music, effects, filters, and stickers allow one-click template application to quickly generate professional-style videos. AI features include automatic caption generation, background removal, smart cutout, and video style transfer. Supports use across computer and mobile platforms with cloud project sync. CapCut for Business provides brand kits and team collaboration features. Completely free core features combined with simple and intuitive operation have driven monthly active users past 200 million, making it one of the most commonly used editing tools for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts creators.
figma-jam: FigJam is Figma's online collaborative whiteboard tool designed specifically for designers and product teams, providing a lightweight and flexible space for brainstorming, information architecture organization, and design discussions. Seamlessly connects with Figma design files, allowing designers to directly embed design drafts into whiteboards for review discussions. Built-in interactive tools including sticky notes, stickers, voting, and timers make workshops and collaboration meetings more engaging. Rich templates cover common design work scenarios including user journey maps, affinity diagrams, and design sprint processes. Supports real-time multi-user collaboration with cursor following and emoji reactions enhancing interactivity. Available as part of a Figma subscription, it is an efficient tool for product and design teams to conduct remote collaborative discussions.
mural: MURAL is an enterprise visual collaboration platform designed for large organizations and complex team collaboration, providing unlimited canvas digital workspaces supporting design thinking, agile development, and strategic planning scenarios. Offers 300+ templates designed by methodology experts covering professional frameworks including value proposition canvas, user story mapping, and product roadmaps. The Facilitation Superpowers toolkit makes remote workshops more orderly and participatory, supporting timing, voting, and content hiding features. Deep integration with Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, Jira, and Slack fits into enterprise workflows. Widely adopted by Fortune 500 companies including IBM, Coca-Cola, and Netflix, offering team and enterprise paid subscription plans, it is the professional tool for large organizations conducting digital collaboration.
notion-calendar: Notion Calendar (formerly Cron) is a next-generation calendar application acquired by Notion, designed for knowledge workers that deeply integrates schedule management with the Notion workspace. The interface is extremely clean and fluid, supporting multi-account Google Calendar sync with a time-block scheduling view that makes a day's work arrangements immediately clear. Bidirectional linking with Notion databases allows directly viewing and editing associated project tasks and meeting notes from the calendar. Meeting links are automatically recognized and displayed, joining meetings with a single click. Cross-timezone display is supported, extremely useful for users coordinating global team meetings. Available in free and integrated Notion paid plans, it is an elegant time management tool for efficiency-focused professionals.
loom: Loom is the pioneer of asynchronous video communication tools, allowing users to quickly record screen, camera, and audio to generate shareable links for team members to view at any time, dramatically reducing unnecessary meetings. Shareable links are generated immediately upon recording without upload waiting, with viewers able to add comments and emoji reactions on the video timeline for highly efficient communication. AI features automatically generate video captions, summaries, and chapter markers. Deep integration with Slack, Notion, GitHub, and other tools fits into team workflows. Offering a free tier with up to 5-minute recordings per video and paid tiers unlocking more features, it is the efficient communication tool for remote teams, product managers, and customer support teams. Atlassian acquired it for approximately $975 million.
typeform: Typeform is an online form and survey tool renowned for exceptional user experience, with its pioneering conversational one-question-at-a-time design making form filling feel more like conversing with a person, significantly improving completion rates. Rich templates cover user research, lead capture, NPS surveys, event registration, and other scenarios, supporting logic branching and personalized question paths. Embedded images, videos, and GIFs make forms more engaging, with brand customization features maintaining visual consistency. Seamlessly integrates with HubSpot, Salesforce, Mailchimp, Zapier, and other tools. Available in free basic and paid tiers, with paid plans unlocking more responses and advanced features, making it the preferred form tool for brand marketing, user research, and event operations teams.
webflow: Webflow is a no-code website building platform for professional web designers, providing pixel-level visual design control while automatically generating clean HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code. Designers can fully control typography, animations, and interactions without compromising to template limitations. Webflow CMS supports flexible content management, Webflow Commerce provides e-commerce features, and Editor allows non-technical users to safely edit content. Websites hosted on Webflow are accelerated by global CDN for security and reliability. Offering a free basic tier and monthly plans, paid tiers support custom domains and more pages. It is the most powerful tool for designers to build websites independently without relying on developers, widely used in creative agencies and SaaS company landing page design.
wordpress: WordPress is the world's largest website building platform by market share, powering over 43% of websites on the internet, from personal blogs to The New York Times and the White House website. Open-source and free with over 59,000 plugins and thousands of themes for extreme extensibility. WordPress.com provides hosting services to lower the technical barrier, while WordPress.org allows fully self-hosted deployment. The WooCommerce e-commerce plugin transforms it into a powerful online store platform. The Gutenberg block editor continuously improves the content creation experience. For bloggers, SMBs, media organizations, and developers, WordPress's vast ecosystem and community resources make it the most cost-effective choice for establishing an online presence.
squarespace: Squarespace is an all-in-one website building platform renowned for beautiful templates and quality user experience, offering a complete solution integrating website design, domain registration, hosting, e-commerce, and marketing. Template design quality is industry-leading with every template meticulously crafted by professional designers, particularly suited for photographers, creative professionals, restaurants, and boutique brands showcasing their image. The drag-and-drop editor is simple and intuitive with built-in SEO tools, email marketing, and social media integration. E-commerce features support physical and digital product sales with seamless Stripe and PayPal integration. Offering 14-day free trials and monthly subscription plans, it is the preferred platform for brands and individuals who prioritize visual quality.
wix: Wix is one of the world's largest website building platforms by user count, known for its extremely low barrier and powerful AI website building features, with over 200 million registered users. The ADI (Artificial Design Intelligence) feature automatically generates complete websites based on user descriptions, enabling zero-experience users to build a website within minutes. Offers 900+ templates covering business websites, personal portfolios, restaurants, e-commerce, and other scenarios. The Wix App Market provides hundreds of feature extension applications. Supports blogs, e-commerce, booking systems, and membership features. Offering a fully functional free tier (with advertising watermark) and paid tiers (custom domain and ad removal), it is one of the most straightforward ways for individuals and small businesses to quickly establish an online presence.
hubspot: HubSpot is the world's leading inbound marketing and CRM platform, providing SMBs with complete marketing funnel solutions from lead attraction to conversion. The free CRM is powerful, supporting contact management, sales pipeline tracking, and email templates. Marketing Hub provides landing pages, forms, email marketing, and ad management tools; Sales Hub automates sales processes; Service Hub manages customer support. HubSpot Academy offers free digital marketing certification courses. Offering a feature-rich free tier and Starter, Professional, and Enterprise paid plans, it is the preferred platform for growing companies building complete marketing and sales systems, having served over 180,000 enterprise customers.
mailchimp: Mailchimp is the world's most well-known email marketing platform, helping SMBs build and maintain email lists and send professional marketing emails with ease of use and rich features. The drag-and-drop email editor and hundreds of templates enable designing professional emails without any technical background. Automated workflows can trigger personalized email sequences based on user behavior to improve conversion rates. Audience segmentation supports precise targeted sending, with A/B testing optimizing subject lines and content effectiveness. Provides analytics reports tracking key metrics like open rates and click rates. The free tier supports 500 contacts and 1,000 emails per month, with paid tiers unlocking more contacts and advanced features, making it the go-to introductory email marketing choice for e-commerce, bloggers, and small businesses.
zapier: Zapier is the world's leading no-code automation platform, connecting over 7,000 applications through Zaps to enable non-technical users to automate repetitive workflows without writing any code. Users set trigger and action rules to achieve cross-app data synchronization and task automation — for example, automatically creating a Trello task when a Gmail email is received. Supports multi-step Zaps and conditional logic to build complex business automation workflows. Seamlessly connects with Slack, Google Workspace, Salesforce, HubSpot, and thousands of other tools. Offering a free tier with limited Zap runs and paid tiers billed by task volume, it is the core tool for marketers, operations teams, and startups to improve work efficiency and reduce manual operations.
grammarly: Grammarly is the world's most popular AI writing assistant, capable of real-time detection and correction of English grammar, spelling, punctuation, and word choice errors, while providing multi-dimensional writing suggestions for tone, clarity, and conciseness. Browser extensions assist in real-time writing across virtually all web input fields including Gmail, Google Docs, LinkedIn, and Twitter. Premium paid tier provides deeper writing suggestions including sentence structure optimization, vocabulary enrichment, and tone adjustment. Grammarly Business provides brand tone consistency management for enterprise teams. Offering free basic and Premium and Business paid subscriptions used by over 30 million users daily, it is the preferred tool for non-native English speakers to improve their English writing quality.
deepl: DeepL is widely recognized as the highest-quality AI translation tool, especially excelling in European language pairs and routinely outperforming Google Translate and Microsoft Translator. Its neural network captures subtle nuances of context and tone, producing natural-sounding translations rather than word-for-word renderings. DeepL supports 31 languages and is available via web, desktop app, and browser extensions. DeepL Pro adds document translation for PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files, API access for developers, and team collaboration features — making it the go-to choice for legal, medical, and academic professionals. A generous free tier works well for individual users.
appletv: Apple TV+ is Apple's premium streaming service built around exclusive, award-winning original content. Rather than competing on volume, Apple TV+ focuses on quality: productions like Ted Lasso, Severance, and The Morning Show have won Emmy and Golden Globe awards. Content streams in 4K HDR with Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos audio, delivering a top-tier viewing experience. New Apple device purchases include a free trial, and the subscription fee is among the most affordable in streaming. Family Sharing allows up to six members to share one account, and bundling with Apple One adds Apple Music, Arcade, and iCloud+ storage.
disneyplus: Disney+ is the official streaming home of Disney, Marvel, Star Wars, Pixar, and National Geographic — making it the most family-friendly and IP-rich streaming service available. Subscribers enjoy 4K Ultra HD, HDR, and ad-free viewing across all content. Global subscriber count has surpassed 150 million. The Disney Bundle combines Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN+ at a compelling price, giving sports fans, adults, and families everything in one subscription. New Marvel series and Star Wars shows premiere exclusively on Disney+, keeping subscribers returning each week for must-watch appointment television.
soundcloud: SoundCloud is the world's largest open audio platform, hosting over 320 million tracks from independent artists, producers, and podcasters worldwide. Unlike major streaming services, any creator can upload and share music directly with a global audience without a record deal. The Repost network helps emerging artists grow quickly, while the distinctive waveform comment system lets fans timestamp reactions to specific moments. SoundCloud Go+ enables offline listening and ad-free playback. The platform is the spiritual home of SoundCloud rap, lo-fi beats, and underground electronic music — often the first place genre-defining tracks appear before mainstream discovery.
iqiyi: iQIYI is one of China's leading video streaming platforms under Baidu, known for high-budget original dramas, variety shows, and exclusive licensed content. Hit series like Hidden Corner and The Bad Kids helped establish iQIYI as the home of suspenseful, critically acclaimed Chinese dramas. The platform reports over 500 million monthly active users, with a tiered VIP membership system offering exclusive early access and HD streaming. The international app iQIYI International brings Chinese content to Southeast Asia and beyond. iQIYI is also known for its aggressive premium content monetization model, including ahead-of-schedule episode unlocks that sparked industry-wide debate.
youku: Youku is Alibaba Group's video streaming platform, leveraging Alibaba Pictures' investment pipeline to secure exclusive rights to major Chinese film and TV productions. The platform integrates deeply with Alibaba's broader ecosystem — 88VIP membership unlocks Youku benefits alongside Taobao, Tmall, and Alipay. Signature variety shows like This Is Street Dance became cultural landmarks, and Youku continues investing in costume dramas and original animation. PC and mobile experiences are well-optimized, with picture-in-picture and casting support across devices. Alibaba Cloud powers the infrastructure for reliable 4K streaming at scale.
tencentvideo: Tencent Video is one of China's most-watched streaming services, backed by Tencent's massive IP library and content investments. Blockbuster exclusives like Joy of Life and Court Lady draw tens of millions of viewers per episode. WeChat and QQ account integration makes login seamless for Tencent's 1.3 billion user base. The platform holds rights to major sports events including the English Premier League and NBA, while 4K Dolby Vision content expands steadily. Tencent Pictures co-productions premiere simultaneously on-platform. The international app WeTV has established a significant presence across Southeast Asia.
neteasemusic: NetEase Music (NetEase Cloud Music) is China's most beloved music streaming platform among younger users, famous for its unique 'comment culture' — heartfelt personal stories and witty observations posted on song pages have become a social phenomenon of their own. The 'Daily Recommendations' algorithm is praised for surfacing indie and niche music that larger platforms miss. The Yuncun community lets artists livestream and interact with fans. Hi-Res and lossless audio is available to VIP subscribers. NetEase Music has carved out a distinct identity through community-first design in a market otherwise dominated by Tencent Music.
qqmusic: QQ Music is Tencent Music Entertainment's flagship streaming service, boasting the widest licensed catalog in China thanks to Tencent's negotiating power with major labels. Many top Chinese pop albums launch as QQ Music exclusives, making it the platform of choice for fans of mainstream pop and idol groups. Green Diamond VIP unlocks FLAC and Hi-Res lossless audio, plus exclusive deluxe album editions. Deep integration with WeChat and QQ makes sharing music effortless for Tencent's massive user base. Beyond streaming, QQ Music offers digital album sales, fan support activities, and concert ticketing — a full-service music ecosystem for fans.
ximalaya: Ximalaya is China's largest audio content platform with over 300 million monthly active users, offering audiobooks, podcasts, stand-up comedy, radio dramas, and paid knowledge courses. Ximalaya pioneered the knowledge economy in China: landmark paid programs like Speak Well and Xue Zhaofeng's economics course launched the concept of paying for audio learning content. The platform has licensing partnerships with over 2,000 publishers, making it the definitive destination for audiobook versions of Chinese and translated titles. Deep integration with in-car systems across multiple domestic auto brands makes Ximalaya the default audio companion for Chinese drivers.
vimeo: Vimeo is the professional video hosting and sharing platform of choice for filmmakers, agencies, and creative professionals who demand quality over quantity. Unlike YouTube, Vimeo offers a completely ad-free viewing experience, superior video fidelity with 4K HDR support, and a sophisticated player that can be customized and embedded anywhere. Vimeo OTT allows creators to build subscription-based streaming channels and monetize their content directly. The Vimeo Review tool is widely adopted in post-production and advertising workflows for client-facing video approvals. Plans are priced by storage and upload bandwidth rather than views, making costs predictable for professional video studios.
techcrunch: TechCrunch is one of the most authoritative technology journalism outlets in the world, founded in 2005 and focused on Silicon Valley startup culture, venture capital news, and tech product launches. Breaking funding rounds, acquisition announcements, and product debuts are TechCrunch specialties — often the first publication to break a major VC deal. The annual TechCrunch Disrupt conference is a prestigious launchpad where startups gain massive visibility competing in the Startup Battlefield. Writing style is direct and often critical, holding tech companies accountable. Owned by Yahoo but maintaining editorial independence, TechCrunch remains essential reading for founders, investors, and product teams globally.
theverge: The Verge is Vox Media's flagship technology and culture publication, celebrated for its beautifully produced video reviews, sharp editorial opinions, and coverage that extends beyond gadgets to examine technology's broader social and political impact. Smartphone, headphone, and consumer electronics reviews carry significant weight in the industry, often shaping mainstream perception of new products. The Verge's YouTube channel sets the bar for production quality in tech video journalism. Beyond products, The Verge covers platform governance, labor in tech, and digital rights with depth and perspective. Its audience skews toward educated, design-conscious readers who engage critically with technology rather than as pure consumerism.
36kr: 36Kr is China's most influential technology and startup media brand, reporting on the Chinese venture capital and tech ecosystem since 2010. The publication is the go-to source for funding announcements, product launches, and company news from the Chinese startup world, breaking stories quickly and reliably. Beyond media, 36Kr has built an ecosystem of enterprise services, investment data tools, and live events connecting startups with investors. Dedicated verticals like 36Kr Global cover Chinese tech companies expanding internationally, while Jiqizhi (Machine Intelligence) provides deep AI coverage. For understanding the Chinese startup landscape and tracking China-based funding activity, 36Kr is indispensable.
huxiu: Huxiu is China's leading platform for in-depth technology and business analysis, distinguishing itself from fast-paced news sites by prioritizing thoughtful long-form articles written by industry insiders, analysts, and practitioners. Articles offer high information density and unique perspectives that go beyond surface-level reporting. The comment section maintains unusually high quality for a Chinese media platform, with substantive discussion from knowledgeable readers. The F&M Club paid membership provides exclusive research reports and analytical content. In an era of content overload, Huxiu has cultivated a loyal readership of tech professionals and investors who value depth over speed, making it a must-read for serious China-tech followers.
sspai: Sspai is China's highest-quality digital lifestyle media platform, built around Apple ecosystem coverage, productivity tools, desktop customization, and technology deep dives. Editorial standards are exceptionally high, and the Matrix creator community attracts writers who produce authoritative reviews of digital tools and workflows. Prime membership unlocks curated exclusive content. Sspai also operates a curated software marketplace applying the same quality-over-quantity philosophy to app discovery. For Chinese users who care about optimizing their digital workflows and using the right tools, Sspai serves as the essential reference guide — the closest equivalent to Wirecutter combined with MacStories in the Chinese digital media landscape.
ifanr: iPhonefanr (ifanr) is a Chinese digital media outlet known for its elegant writing style and aesthetic sensibility, covering tech products and digital lifestyle through a design-conscious lens that sets it apart from conventional gadget publications. First-look reviews of major Apple, Sony, and DJI launches are consistently well-crafted, emphasizing how products integrate into everyday life rather than leading with specs. The ifanr community attracts urban professionals and design enthusiasts interested in the intersection of technology and lifestyle aesthetics. Coverage often highlights design philosophy and user experience over raw performance benchmarks. For reaching design-aware Chinese tech consumers, ifanr delivers genuinely engaged, quality-conscious readership.
zhihu: Zhihu is China's largest knowledge Q&A and content community, comparable to a blend of Quora and Reddit but with notably higher average answer quality in specialized professional domains. Experts, academics, and industry practitioners across medicine, law, technology, history, and business contribute detailed, well-researched responses to complex questions. Salt Select (盐选) offers premium long-form content from established writers and journalists. Zhihu Live enables real-time knowledge-sharing sessions for audiences. For students, researchers, and professionals seeking high-quality Chinese-language expert perspectives, Zhihu is the definitive resource. It also provides an invaluable window into how educated Chinese internet users debate, discuss, and analyze ideas across every domain.
ebay: eBay is one of the world's oldest and largest online marketplaces, founded in 1995 and originally built around auction-style listings that democratized buying and selling rare and secondhand goods. Today eBay operates as both an auction and fixed-price marketplace with over 132 million active buyers globally. Product categories span vintage collectibles, consumer electronics, auto parts, fashion, and rare memorabilia — making it the definitive destination for items unavailable in conventional retail channels. The eBay Money Back Guarantee protects buyers on virtually all transactions. For cross-border shoppers, resellers sourcing inventory, and collectors hunting specific items, eBay remains genuinely irreplaceable as a massive global aggregator of unique and hard-to-find products.
taobao: Taobao is Alibaba's C2C and small merchant marketplace — China's largest shopping platform by product variety and daily active users. With hundreds of millions of SKUs spanning factory-direct goods, artisan crafts, vintage fashion, and everyday household items, virtually anything can be found on Taobao at competitive prices. Taobao Live is China's most mature livestream commerce ecosystem, with top influencers generating hundreds of millions of yuan in single-session sales events. The platform pioneered China's shopping festival culture with Double 11 (Singles' Day), now the world's largest annual shopping event by transaction volume. For Chinese consumers, Taobao functions as the essential first-stop discovery and purchase channel for everyday commerce.
jd: JD.com (Jingdong) is China's largest self-operated e-commerce platform, built on a foundation of genuine product guarantees, industry-leading logistics, and reliable after-sales service. Its proprietary logistics network delivers same-day or next-day to most Chinese cities — the fastest delivery in Chinese e-commerce. JD dominates in electronics, home appliances, and computer hardware categories, where authenticity concerns make its brand-operated model especially valued. JD PLUS membership provides shipping credits, exclusive discounts, and financial benefits. The 618 Shopping Festival, invented by JD, has grown into a nationwide shopping event rivaling Alibaba's Double 11. JD Health, JD Industrial, and other verticals extend the model into B2B and specialized markets.
pinduoduo: Pinduoduo is China's fastest-growing e-commerce platform, having surpassed Taobao in monthly active users through an aggressive low-price strategy and viral social mechanics. Core features include group buying (tuan gou) for lower prices, friend-invitation bargaining campaigns, and the Billion Subsidy program offering brand-name goods at steep discounts. A pioneering agricultural supply chain directly connects farmers to consumers, reducing food prices and supporting rural communities. Duoduo Grocery is a leading community group-buying service. The international version Temu has rapidly expanded across North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia with the same ultra-low-price model, reaching 18B USD GMV in 2023 and reshaping global retail expectations.
xiaohongshu: Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book / RED) is China's unique content-commerce hybrid platform where lifestyle inspiration and shopping discovery converge. Users share photo and short-video content around beauty, fashion, food, travel, and home decor, creating a peer-review culture that carries significantly more trust than traditional advertising. With over 300 million monthly active users — predominantly urban women aged 18-35 with strong purchasing power — Xiaohongshu is the definitive discovery platform for premium consumer brands entering the Chinese market. Brand notes, KOL partnerships, and shoppable posts are the primary marketing formats. International luxury and beauty brands and domestic new consumer brands alike treat Xiaohongshu presence as essential for reaching young Chinese shoppers.
shein: SHEIN is the world's fastest-growing cross-border fast fashion e-commerce platform, disrupting global apparel retail with ultra-low prices and an extreme speed-to-market supply chain. The platform adds over 6,000 new items daily, powered by a sophisticated demand-sensing system that enables small-batch rapid replenishment with near-zero inventory risk. SHEIN has topped shopping app download charts across the US, UK, and Europe, becoming a genuine cultural phenomenon among Gen Z shoppers. Despite facing criticism over labor practices and environmental impact, the combination of unbeatable prices and vast selection has given SHEIN dominant market position in fashion categories globally across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia.
depop: Depop is the secondhand fashion marketplace built for Gen Z, combining the social browsing experience of Instagram with peer-to-peer resale. Sellers set up storefronts that followers can browse and shop directly, with in-app messaging enabling direct buyer-seller negotiation. The platform specializes in vintage clothing, rare sneakers, Y2K fashion, and indie aesthetic pieces — categories that attract a community genuinely passionate about sustainable and individual style. Depop is often the first place limited-edition collaborations and coveted vintage finds appear. Acquired by Etsy for 1.6 billion USD in 2021, Depop continues expanding its presence among fashion-forward young adults across the US, UK, and Australia.
gog: GOG is the DRM-free game distribution platform operated by CD Projekt, the studio behind The Witcher and Cyberpunk 2077. GOG's defining principle is that purchasing a game means truly owning it — no always-online requirements, no digital rights management software, just a game file you keep forever. The platform is the definitive home for classic PC games from the 1990s and 2000s, relicensed and patched to run on modern systems. GOG Galaxy provides a unified launcher that aggregates games across Steam, Epic, Origin, and other platforms alongside GOG titles. Regular sales, giveaways, and the catalog of lovingly preserved classics make GOG the platform of choice for players who care about game ownership and preservation.
humble: Humble Bundle is the charitable gaming platform that pioneered pay-what-you-want game bundles, letting players set their own prices for curated game collections while allocating a portion of proceeds to charity. Since founding, the platform has raised over 250 million USD for charitable causes. Humble Choice is a monthly subscription service delivering a selection of premium games each month. The Humble Store offers regular discounts on individual titles, frequently matching or beating Steam prices. Beyond games, Humble has expanded into book bundles, software collections, and comic packs. For value-conscious players who want quality games at great prices while simultaneously supporting good causes, Humble Bundle offers a uniquely compelling proposition.
opgg: OP.GG is the most-used League of Legends player statistics and analytics platform, providing real-time win rates, KDA breakdowns, champion tier rankings, and matchup data that help players understand the current meta and optimize their champion pool. The in-client pre-game analysis feature lets players review teammates' and opponents' recent performance before a match begins, informing champion select decisions. Champion guides and recommended builds are continuously updated by the OP.GG team based on aggregated high-elo data. The platform has expanded to cover Wild Rift, VALORANT, and PUBG analytics. For serious League players looking to climb the ranked ladder, OP.GG is the essential companion tool.
nexusmods: Nexus Mods is the world's largest video game modding community and mod download platform, hosting millions of mods across tens of thousands of games. The platform is the beating heart of modding culture for titles like The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, Fallout 4, Cyberpunk 2077, and Stardew Valley — where fan-created content can radically transform gameplay, graphics, and storytelling. Top mods have amassed tens of millions of downloads, rivaling the popularity of the base games themselves. The Vortex mod manager helps players safely install, activate, and manage complex mod load orders. Premium membership removes download speed limits. Nexus Mods represents the vital bridge between fan creativity and the longevity of beloved single-player games.
speedrun: Speedrun.com is the authoritative database and leaderboard platform for the global speedrunning community, cataloging world record runs and category rankings across thousands of video games. Players submit video evidence of their runs for verification by community moderators, ensuring records are legitimate. Supported categories range from Any% (fastest completion regardless of method) to 100% (full completion) and dozens of game-specific subcategories. The platform is closely connected to Games Done Quick (GDQ), the charity speedrunning marathon that regularly raises millions for medical charities. Speedrunning culture has spawned a thriving content creator ecosystem on Twitch and YouTube, turning competitive any% runs into compelling spectator entertainment.
liquipedia: Liquipedia is the world's most comprehensive esports wiki and tournament database, covering leagues, events, rosters, and match histories across CS2, Dota 2, League of Legends, VALORANT, StarCraft II, and dozens of other competitive titles. Content is collaboratively maintained by a passionate global community, achieving a level of real-time accuracy and depth that dedicated editorial teams cannot match. Professional teams, coaches, and analysts frequently update their own Liquipedia pages. For esports media professionals, broadcast commentators, and event organizers, Liquipedia is an indispensable reference. For fans following competitive scenes, it is the definitive place to track tournament brackets, check head-to-head records, and understand the history of any player or team.
wegame: WeGame is Tencent's proprietary game distribution and community platform, serving as the official launcher for Tencent's major PC titles including League of Legends, Dungeon Fighter Online (DNF), and Naraka: Bladepoint. The platform provides download acceleration, in-game communities, livestreaming, and match history analytics within a single ecosystem. Tencent's gaming account system is deeply integrated with WeGame, meaning players managing multiple Tencent games do so from one unified hub. Network acceleration features are optimized specifically for China's domestic internet infrastructure. WeGame represents Tencent's effort to consolidate its gaming ecosystem and player community in the same way Steam has done globally, with the weight of Tencent's dominant IP portfolio behind it.
edx: edX is a premier online learning platform co-founded by Harvard University and MIT, offering rigorous academic courses from over 160 leading universities and institutions worldwide. Subject areas span computer science, data science, business, engineering, humanities, and professional development. MicroMasters and Professional Certificate programs are recognized by major employers and, in some cases, can be credited toward full degree programs. The platform's audit mode allows anyone to access course content from Harvard, MIT, and other elite universities entirely for free, with verified certificates available for a fee. Following acquisition by 2U, edX continues expanding its enterprise learning offerings. For learners worldwide seeking genuinely rigorous higher-education-caliber content, edX represents remarkable access to world-class instruction.
skillshare: Skillshare is an online learning community centered on creative and entrepreneurial skills, offering an all-access subscription model with thousands of courses covering illustration, graphic design, photography, video production, writing, UX design, and business development. What distinguishes Skillshare is that courses are taught by working practitioners and creative professionals rather than academic instructors, keeping content grounded in real-world application. Courses are project-based and shorter than typical university MOOCs, making them ideal for building tangible skills quickly. Skillshare's open creator model allows practitioners to monetize their expertise by publishing courses, fueling a rich ecosystem of niche and specialized content. For anyone looking to enter or advance in creative fields, Skillshare offers an efficient and inspiring learning environment.
codecademy: Codecademy is the most beginner-friendly online programming education platform in the world, built around an interactive in-browser coding environment that eliminates setup friction entirely — learners write and run code immediately within the web page, seeing results in real time. Core tracks cover Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, SQL, Java, and data science, structured into career-path programs with clear progressions from fundamentals to job-ready skills. Codecademy Pro adds quizzes, projects, and certificates of completion that learners can add to resumes and LinkedIn profiles. The platform has introduced over 50 million learners to programming globally, making it one of the most impactful coding education tools ever created. Its combination of zero setup, immediate feedback, and structured curriculum makes it uniquely effective for absolute beginners.
freecodecamp: freeCodeCamp is a nonprofit organization providing completely free, comprehensive programming education through a structured curriculum covering responsive web design, JavaScript algorithms, front-end libraries, back-end development, data analysis, and machine learning. Upon completing each certification curriculum, learners receive a free, verifiable certificate to share on LinkedIn and resumes. The organization's YouTube channel with over 9 million subscribers is one of the largest free programming tutorial resources on the internet. The freeCodeCamp publication on Medium features high-quality technical articles from the community. A vibrant forum supports learners through the curriculum. Having helped tens of thousands of people successfully transition into software development careers, freeCodeCamp may be the single most impactful free programming education resource ever created.
wolfram: Wolfram Alpha is a computational knowledge engine that directly computes answers rather than returning lists of links. Users can input mathematical equations and receive step-by-step solutions, query chemical compound properties, look up physical constants, perform statistical calculations, or analyze date relationships — and Wolfram Alpha interprets the intent and delivers precise computed results with supporting visualizations. Powered by the Wolfram Language's curated knowledge base spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry, life sciences, geography, history, and finance, the engine covers an extraordinary breadth of domains. Wolfram Alpha Pro supports custom data uploads and more complex computational workflows. For students checking homework solutions, researchers performing quick numerical verification, and curious minds exploring quantitative questions, Wolfram Alpha is genuinely irreplaceable.
mooc: China University MOOC (icourse163.org) is China's largest government-supported online course platform, co-built by NetEase and top Chinese universities including Tsinghua, Peking University, Fudan, and Zhejiang University. Courses span science, engineering, humanities, economics, management, and arts — taught by actual university professors and structured like official campus courses with assignments, exams, and discussion forums. Completion earns platform certificates, and some courses qualify for credit transfer recognition. For working adults pursuing continuing education and students unable to access elite institutions, China University MOOC democratizes access to China's finest higher education resources. The vast majority of course content is completely free, making high-quality university instruction broadly accessible.
dedao: Dedao is China's leading knowledge-economy platform founded by media personality Luo Zhenyu, specializing in premium audio courses designed for efficient learning during commutes and daily routines. The platform rigorously curates instructors — each course undergoes strict editorial review for topic selection and content quality. Landmark courses like Liu Run's Business Thinking, Xue Zhaofeng's Economics, and Li Xiang's Business Review became cultural touchstones of China's knowledge-payment era. Dedao e-books and audiobook summaries extend the learning ecosystem beyond courses. The annual cross-year speech event has become a signature cultural event in China's intellectual community. For Chinese professionals seeking to systematically upgrade their thinking and business acumen through high-quality curated content, Dedao is the most trusted paid learning platform.
anki: Anki is a spaced-repetition flashcard application built on the SM-2 algorithm, which intelligently schedules review sessions to present cards just before they would be forgotten, maximizing long-term retention with minimum study time. The result is dramatically more efficient memorization compared to traditional rote repetition methods. Anki has near-cult status among medical students — who use it to master vast pharmacology, anatomy, and clinical knowledge — and language learners who rely on it for vocabulary acquisition. AnkiWeb synchronizes card decks across devices, while AnkiDroid and AnkiMobile bring the system to Android and iOS. Thousands of community-shared decks covering USMLE Step 1, JLPT, IELTS, and countless other subjects are freely downloadable, giving new learners a head start without building from scratch.
binance: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, founded by Changpeng Zhao (CZ) in 2017 and achieving market dominance with extraordinary speed. The platform supports spot trading for 350+ cryptocurrencies alongside futures, leveraged trading, options, staking, DeFi yield products, and an NFT marketplace — making it the most comprehensive crypto exchange ecosystem. BNB (Binance Coin) holders receive trading fee discounts and access to exclusive token launches. Binance's liquidity depth minimizes slippage even on large orders. Following a landmark regulatory settlement in 2023 in which CZ stepped down and Binance paid significant fines, the platform has undertaken compliance restructuring while maintaining its dominant market position globally.
okx: OKX (formerly OKEx) is a top-three global crypto exchange distinguished by its leadership in Web3 infrastructure, particularly the OKX Wallet — widely regarded as one of the best multi-chain non-custodial wallets available. The exchange provides spot, futures, options, and DeFi yield products across 340+ assets. The OKX DEX aggregator connects decentralized exchange liquidity across multiple blockchains in a single interface. OKX Ventures invests broadly across Layer 1 infrastructure, GameFi, and SocialFi ecosystems. As the official naming sponsor of Manchester City Football Club, OKX has invested significantly in global brand building. Chinese-language interface and support quality make OKX a preferred choice for Chinese-speaking users navigating international crypto markets.
coinmarketcap: CoinMarketCap is the crypto industry's most authoritative market data platform, tracking real-time prices, market capitalizations, trading volumes, circulating supply, and historical data for over 20,000 cryptocurrencies and digital assets. Acquired by Binance in 2020 while maintaining data independence, CoinMarketCap's total crypto market cap figures are cited daily by media outlets, analysts, and institutional investors as the de facto industry benchmark. Beyond price data, the platform offers exchange rankings, new listing alerts, a crypto news aggregator, portfolio tracking tools, and an educational Learn & Earn section. For anyone following the crypto markets — from casual observers to professional traders — CoinMarketCap is the essential daily dashboard.
investopedia: Investopedia is the world's largest financial education website, offering systematic coverage of stocks, bonds, options, funds, forex, cryptocurrencies, and personal finance through over 34,000 term definitions, how-to tutorials, and in-depth explainers. For beginners, entries are written in accessible language with concrete examples; for advanced learners, topics like options strategies, technical analysis, and valuation methods are covered with professional depth. Investopedia Academy offers paid courses for structured financial education. The Investopedia Stock Simulator lets users practice investment decisions with virtual capital risk-free. Whether studying for the CFA exam, planning personal finances, or simply trying to understand what a term means after reading the news, Investopedia is the most trusted free English-language financial reference resource.
xueqiu: Xueqiu (Snow Ball) is China's most active investment social community, with over 20 million registered users sharing stock analysis, portfolio performance, and investment ideas across A-shares, Hong Kong, and US equities. The platform's Portfolio feature lets users create and publish real or virtual portfolios with verifiable return tracking, attracting many professional fund managers and analysts who publicly share their holdings and theses. Xueqiu's fund marketplace offers direct low-commission fund purchases. Xueqiu Securities (NASDAQ-listed) provides brokerage services for Hong Kong and US markets. For Chinese retail investors seeking a community to research listed companies, discover strong fund managers, and exchange investment perspectives, Xueqiu is the definitive social platform.
eastmoney: East Money (Dongfang Cafu) is China's most comprehensive financial portal and services ecosystem, with market data, financial statements, analyst research, and the Guba stock forum all holding dominant positions in their respective categories. The Choice financial data terminal is a professional-grade institutional analytics tool that rivals Wind as one of China's two leading financial data platforms. Tiantian Fund (天天基金), also under East Money, is China's largest online fund distribution platform with over one trillion RMB in assets under management. The East Money app integrates real-time quotes, news, watchlists, and brokerage functionality, making it the most-used stock trading companion app in China.
alipay: Alipay is China's largest third-party payment and comprehensive financial services platform, operated by Ant Group (an Alibaba affiliate) with over one billion monthly active users. Payment functionality covers online shopping, offline QR code payments, peer transfers, red packets, and bill payments across virtually every life scenario. Financial services include Yu'e Bao money market fund, Huabei credit spending, Jiebei personal loans, and insurance and fund investment products. The Sesame Credit scoring system was China's earliest consumer credit rating product. Mini-program integration enables hundreds of thousands of services without requiring separate app downloads. Alipay International has established significant presence across Southeast Asia and Europe through eWallet partnerships, serving both overseas Chinese communities and local users.
weibo: Weibo is China's largest public social media platform, functioning as a hybrid of Twitter and Instagram with microblogging, image, and short video capabilities. Its Hot Search (热搜) list functions as a real-time national attention meter — virtually every major breaking news story, celebrity controversy, or social event trends on Weibo first. Celebrity fan clubs, brand communities, and influencer marketing ecosystems are highly developed, making Weibo indispensable for entertainment marketing in China. The Super Topic (超话) system and fan support mechanics have shaped the economics of China's entire entertainment industry. For brands seeking to participate in Chinese public discourse and real-time conversation, Weibo offers unmatched reach to the country's most culturally engaged audiences.
wechat: WeChat (Weixin) is Tencent's 1.35 billion monthly active user super-app that has become the central operating system of digital life in China. The platform integrates instant messaging, Moments social feed, WeChat Pay, Official Accounts publishing, Video Account short-form video, and Mini Programs — a complete self-contained digital ecosystem. WeChat Pay rivals Alipay in offline QR code payment penetration, with red packet transfers deeply embedded in Chinese social rituals. Mini Programs host millions of services directly within WeChat, eliminating the need to download separate apps. For brands and businesses, WeChat Official Accounts and enterprise channels are among the most important digital touchpoints for reaching Chinese consumers. Understanding WeChat is essential for understanding how China's digital economy functions.
douyin: Douyin is ByteDance's Chinese short-video platform, powered by the same advanced recommendation algorithm that drives TikTok globally. With over 700 million daily active users, Douyin's immersive full-screen vertical feed and highly personalized content stream have made it the most-watched app in China by total engagement time. The 15-to-60-second format and low content creation barrier democratized video creation across demographics. Douyin e-commerce — combining in-app shops with livestream shopping — has grown into China's third-largest e-commerce ecosystem with over 2 trillion RMB GMV in 2023. As TikTok's Chinese counterpart, Douyin's product innovations (duet features, interactive stickers, shoppable videos) often preview what will eventually launch globally on TikTok.
bluesky: Bluesky is a decentralized microblogging platform built on the AT Protocol, an open social networking standard co-created by Twitter co-founder Jack Dorsey with the goal of giving users genuine data ownership and portability. Unlike centralized platforms, AT Protocol allows users to choose their hosting server and switch between providers without losing their social graph — and even run their own instances. Users can also select or create custom algorithmic feeds rather than being subject to a single platform-imposed recommendation system. Following Elon Musk's acquisition of Twitter, Bluesky experienced rapid growth as journalists, academics, and tech professionals seeking platform alternatives arrived in large numbers, surpassing 20 million users in 2024. Its clean chronological timeline and open protocol design have made it a credible decentralized alternative.
threads: Threads is Meta's text-based social platform tightly integrated with Instagram, launching in July 2023 and reaching 100 million sign-ups within its first week — the fastest app adoption in history. Designed to capture public conversation market share from X (Twitter), Threads leverages Instagram's existing account infrastructure to dramatically lower switching costs for the platform's 2 billion existing users. Threads has committed to ActivityPub federation support, positioning it to interoperate with Mastodon and the broader Fediverse — making it the largest single entity to join the decentralized social web. Meta's product development capabilities and advertising infrastructure provide long-term structural advantages. For brands already active on Instagram, Threads offers natural extension into public text-based conversation with a familiar audience.
whatsapp: WhatsApp is Meta's globally dominant instant messaging application with over 2 billion monthly active users across 180+ countries, functioning as the primary communication channel for international business, family connections, and community coordination in markets from India to Brazil to Nigeria. End-to-end encryption on all messages and calls provides strong privacy protection by default. WhatsApp Business provides small and medium enterprises with official accounts, automated messaging, product catalogs, and customer service tools, making it the preferred business communication channel across South Asia, Southeast Asia, Latin America, and Africa. WhatsApp Channels enables broadcast-style content distribution. In European markets, WhatsApp has become standard infrastructure for everything from doctor appointments to government notifications.
snapchat: Snapchat is Snap Inc.'s pioneering ephemeral social media application, known for disappearing messages, 24-hour Stories, and augmented reality filters that have influenced an entire generation of social product design. Snapchat invented Stories, vertical video, and AR lenses — features that Instagram, TikTok, and dozens of other platforms subsequently adopted. Snap Map lets friends share real-time location, strengthening offline social connections. Spotlight short-form video competes directly with TikTok for creator attention. Snap has invested heavily in AR glasses hardware through Spectacles, exploring the next computing paradigm. For advertisers, Snapchat is among the most effective platforms for reaching 13-34-year-olds, particularly in the US, UK, France, and Australia, where the platform maintains high daily engagement rates.
douban: Douban is China's most distinctive cultural community platform, centered on user-generated ratings and reviews of books, films, music, and cultural events. The Douban Rating (豆瓣评分) has become the authoritative benchmark for Chinese cinema and literature quality, influencing box office outcomes and book sales. Users maintain personal cultural diaries tracking everything they have read, watched, or listened to, creating rich taste profiles. Douban Groups host thousands of niche interest communities spanning topics from philosophy reading clubs and indie music to local rental advice and pet care. Douban FM delivers algorithmically personalized music discovery with an unusually refined aesthetic. For Chinese readers, cinephiles, and cultural consumers, Douban is the essential community for meaningful cultural discussion, making it a cultural institution rather than merely a social platform.
facebook: Facebook is Meta's flagship social network with over 3 billion monthly active users — the largest social platform in human history by reach. Facebook Groups aggregate interest communities, neighborhood networks, and hobby clubs at massive scale; Facebook Marketplace has become the dominant local classifieds and secondhand platform in the United States. Reels competes directly with TikTok for short-form video attention. For global advertisers, Facebook's precision targeting system — backed by Meta's unparalleled cross-platform user data — remains one of the highest-ROI digital marketing channels available, especially for reaching audiences over 30. Facebook Events is the de facto tool for organizing public and community gatherings in Western markets. For businesses expanding internationally, maintaining an active Facebook presence is fundamental to global digital marketing strategy.
qq: QQ is Tencent's pioneering instant messaging platform launched in 1999, maintaining over 500 million monthly active users and remaining the dominant communication tool for Chinese students, teenagers, and gaming communities. QQ has continuously evolved to stay relevant: Channels (Discord-like community spaces), Moments-style short video, and social discovery features actively attract younger users. QQ Zone remains a significant social space for Chinese youth documenting their lives. Unlike WeChat's professional tone, QQ is more playful and entertainment-oriented, with elaborate avatar customization, membership status displays, and gaming integrations. For China's gaming community, QQ remains the most important guild communication and team coordination tool, seamlessly integrated with Tencent's gaming ecosystem.
soul: Soul is a Chinese social app designed for Gen Z built around interest-based matching rather than appearance, with the tagline of finding your soulmate — positioning itself uniquely in the social discovery market. Upon registration, users complete a personality assessment enabling the system to match people by interest and temperament, lowering social barriers for introverted users. Soul Planet, voice party rooms, and AI conversation features represent continuous product innovation. The anonymized profile and virtual avatar system creates a low-pressure social environment where personality matters more than looks. Soul has expanded into soul music discovery and creator tools. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (SOUL), it represents one of China's most distinctive next-generation social products targeting the emerging generation of digital natives.
jike: Jike is a Chinese interest-driven community app whose core proposition is connecting people with shared passions — particularly popular among technology professionals, independent creators, designers, and young people who value thoughtful discourse. Jike's topic-based communities (圈子) aggregate high-quality content around specific interests without the noise of mainstream platforms. The product deliberately avoids aggressive algorithmic recommendations, maintaining a calmer, more intentional content experience that users describe as anti-anxiety. Podcast integration and weekly editorial picks amplify quality creators. While Jike's user scale is modest compared to Weibo or WeChat, its influence within China's tech and startup community is disproportionately large — making it an important platform for reaching thoughtful, engaged professionals who influence industry discourse.
kuaishou: Kuaishou is China's second-largest short-video platform with over 690 million monthly active users, achieving especially deep penetration in third and fourth-tier cities and rural areas — forming a complementary urban-rural split with Douyin. Kuaishou's defining cultural quality is authenticity and community warmth: the relationship between livestreamers and their fans (called laotie or old friends) is characterized by genuine loyalty and emotional connection rather than parasocial celebrity worship. Kuaishou live e-commerce is substantial, with factory-direct and agricultural products as signature categories. Kwai, the international version, has built significant user bases in Brazil, Indonesia, and other emerging markets. Kuaishou's unpolished, genuine content culture occupies a distinct and irreplaceable position in China's social media ecosystem.
hongguo: Hongguo Short Drama (红果短剧) is ByteDance's ad-supported free short drama streaming platform, differentiating itself from competitors through a completely free viewing model where ad revenue, rather than user subscriptions, funds content access. Launched in 2023, the platform surpassed 150 million monthly active users within two years — an astonishing growth rate for any streaming platform. Content focuses on genres popular with mainstream Chinese audiences: urban romance, sweet love stories, and underdog revenge narratives, with each episode running 1-5 minutes — perfectly sized for commute and break-time consumption. ByteDance's recommendation algorithm and Douyin's distribution infrastructure provide Hongguo with powerful content amplification advantages, making it the breakout new player in China's rapidly growing short drama market.
mangotv: Mango TV is Hunan Broadcasting System's streaming platform, whose core competitive advantage lies in exclusive rights to Hunan Satellite TV's acclaimed variety programming and original productions. Landmark shows like Sisters Who Make Waves, Brothers Who Dare to Break Through, and various relationship observation programs have created a powerful IP portfolio that drives strong paid subscription conversion. Mango TV holds clear content barriers in talent competition, romance reality, and outdoor survival variety formats. The Mango Super Media listed entity creates a vertically integrated content production, distribution, and merchandise ecosystem. Among China's video platforms, Mango TV has carved a distinctive market position through variety content differentiation, maintaining monthly active users consistently above 100 million.
primevideo: Prime Video is Amazon's global streaming service available in over 240 countries — the broadest geographic reach of any streaming platform. As a benefit bundled with Amazon Prime membership, Prime Video reaches an enormous subscriber base at effectively zero marginal cost for many users. Original productions including The Rings of Power, The Boys, Fallout, and Jack Ryan have earned major award nominations and strong audience ratings. The Prime Video Channels feature allows subscribers to add Paramount+, MGM+, and other streaming services, creating a one-stop streaming aggregator within the Amazon ecosystem. The X-Ray feature integrates IMDb data to display cast information in real time during playback. For Prime members worldwide, Prime Video delivers substantial entertainment value as part of an already-valuable subscription.
max: Max (formerly HBO Max) is Warner Bros. Discovery's flagship streaming platform, driven by HBO's prestige drama library and Warner Bros. theatrical releases — widely considered the highest-quality content catalog in streaming. Landmark HBO series including Game of Thrones, Succession, Silicon Valley, The White Lotus, and The Penguin consistently define the annual conversation around prestige television. DC Universe superhero films and series, CNN streaming content, and Warner Bros. theatrical premieres round out the catalog. Subscription plans include ad-supported and ad-free tiers, with many theatrical releases landing on Max within weeks of cinema release. For viewers who care deeply about storytelling quality above all else, Max represents the gold standard of streaming content curation.
crunchyroll: Crunchyroll is the world's largest licensed anime streaming platform, hosting over 1,300 titles and 45,000 episodes in partnership with Japan's major animation studios. Simulcast delivery brings subtitled episodes online within hours of Japanese broadcast — the fastest legal route to new anime outside Japan. MEGA Fan and Ultimate Fan memberships unlock ad-free viewing, offline downloads, and access to the full simulcast library. Following merger with Funimation and acquisition by Sony Pictures, Crunchyroll significantly expanded its English-dubbed catalog and North American market presence. Crunchyroll Store offers official merchandise. For anime fans outside Japan seeking comprehensive legal access to both seasonal simulcasts and catalog classics, Crunchyroll is the definitive and irreplaceable platform.
kugou: Kugou Music is China's largest music streaming platform by user count, operated under Tencent Music Entertainment alongside QQ Music and Kuwo. Kugou's distinctive strength is its powerful live music and social ecosystem: Kugou Live was one of China's earliest and largest music livestreaming platforms, providing a significant monetization channel for singers and amateur performers. Karaoke and voice-matching features are particularly popular with mainstream users. Kugou Radio aggregates genre-based content channels. Ringtone downloads and DJ music mixes historically drove significant traffic. In third and fourth-tier cities and among older demographics, Kugou's brand recognition often surpasses QQ Music, making it Tencent Music's most important product for reaching China's mainstream mass market.
migu: Migu Video is China Mobile's streaming platform, uniquely differentiated by an extensive sports rights portfolio that includes exclusive domestic broadcasts of the Chinese Super League, CBA basketball, and Chinese national football team matches, alongside international properties including UEFA Champions League coverage. 5G ultra-high-definition live sports (4K/8K) is a flagship use case for China Mobile's network infrastructure, with Migu serving as the showcase platform. Beyond sports, the platform offers anime, variety shows, and film content. For Chinese sports fans who want to watch premium football, basketball, and athletics content legally through official broadcast rights, Migu Video is an essential subscription — with China Mobile bundle integration making it convenient for existing subscribers.
lizhi: Lizhi is China's leading audio social platform, focused on UGC podcast creation, audio livestreaming, and voice interaction — positioning itself distinctly from Ximalaya's PGC/licensed content model. With over 50 million monthly active users, creators can launch audio livestreams instantly and interact with audiences in real time. Voice Party rooms support multi-person live audio conversations, strengthening community bonds. Lizhi indexes particularly well with female users and Gen Z, with content tones centered on emotional sharing, lifestyle, and music. Listed on NASDAQ (LIZI), Lizhi is the representative public company in China's audio social space, actively exploring voice AI and virtual anchor technologies as next-generation growth vectors in the evolving audio entertainment landscape.
jianying: Jianying (剪映) is ByteDance's video editing application, which has become China's most-used video editing software through an extremely low learning curve combined with powerful AI features, available on both mobile and desktop (as CapCut Pro internationally). Core AI capabilities include one-tap auto-editing, highly accurate automatic subtitle generation, intelligent background removal, and text-to-video generation. The massive library of music assets, sticker effects, and transitions is deeply integrated with Douyin, allowing creators to publish directly to the platform. The international version, CapCut, has become one of the world's most downloaded video editing apps, widely adopted by Instagram Reels and TikTok creators globally, with especially strong growth in Southeast Asia, Latin America, and North America.
toutiao: Toutiao (Today's Headlines) is ByteDance's AI-powered personalized news and content aggregation platform — the company's first major product and the pioneer of algorithm-driven content distribution in China. By analyzing reading behavior, click patterns, and engagement duration, Toutiao builds precise individual interest profiles that deliver a completely personalized content feed to each user, establishing the paradigm of algorithm-over-editor content curation that now defines the industry. The platform's creator ecosystem hosts millions of content producers across categories from politics and finance to human interest stories. With over 200 million monthly active users, Toutiao is a major channel for information consumption in China and an important platform for brands placing native content advertising in a high-engagement editorial environment.
fanqie: Fanqie Novel (番茄小说) is ByteDance's free online fiction reading platform that disrupted China's paid web novel industry with a completely free, ad-supported model — directly challenging Yuewen Group's (Reading Group) dominant paid subscription ecosystem. Within a few years of launch, monthly active users surpassed 100 million, making Fanqie one of China's largest free fiction platforms. A robust creator incentive program attracts quality authors who might otherwise publish exclusively on paid platforms. Content focuses on fast-updating power fantasy genres including cultivation fiction, transmigration stories, and underdog revenge narratives — ideal for quick episodic consumption during commutes. ByteDance's recommendation algorithm dramatically improves book discovery, contributing to reader retention rates that rival or exceed traditional paid platforms.
weread: WeRead (微信读书) is Tencent's licensed ebook platform that broke the per-book pricing model with an unlimited monthly subscription, dramatically reducing the cost of digital reading. Deep integration with WeChat creates a unique social reading ecosystem: friend reading leaderboards, shared highlights, and reading challenges foster community around books. AI Summary helps readers evaluate books before committing to reading them. The library spans over 500,000 licensed titles alongside WeChat Official Account articles, creating a unified content ecosystem. WeRead e-ink hardware readers compete in China's e-reader market. Annual reading reports and weekly reading time rankings have become social currency in reading communities, gamifying the habit of reading in ways that genuinely increase how much users read over time.
qidian: Qidian (起点中文网) is the flagship paid web novel platform of Reading Group (Yuewen Group, majority-owned by Tencent) and the birthplace of China's online fiction industry. With over 8 million contracted authors across fantasy, cultivation, urban fiction, history, and science fiction genres, Qidian has produced some of China's most valuable literary IP. Legendary series including Battle Through the Heavens, The King's Avatar, and Joy of Life originated on Qidian before being adapted into blockbuster TV series and games. Monthly voting, subscription, and tipping systems create a complete monetization ladder where top authors earn millions of yuan annually. Yuewen Group's IP library built through Qidian is now powering a full cross-media expansion into animation, games, films, and audiobooks.
ireader: iReader (掌阅) is one of China's major licensed ebook platforms, originating as an e-reader hardware company and evolving into a software-hardware integrated reading ecosystem. The platform hosts over 500,000 licensed titles spanning literature, history, social science, and business. The iReader e-ink device lineup competes in China's e-reader market alongside Boox and Hanvon, known for slim designs and long battery life. As a reading destination, iReader serves mainstream readers seeking convenient legal access to ebooks across all major categories. Reading list recommendations and celebrity bookshelves help users discover new titles, while reading statistics help users track progress toward personal reading goals. The iReader Enterprise version provides employee learning solutions to corporate clients.
googlenews: Google News is Google's AI-powered news aggregation platform, consolidating coverage from tens of thousands of publishers worldwide into personalized feeds for each user. A defining feature is automatic story clustering — multiple outlets covering the same event are grouped together, allowing readers to compare perspectives and sources rather than getting a single narrative. Local news sections surface timely regional content. Completely free with no subscription required, Google News represents one of the most powerful free news discovery tools available globally. Publisher visibility in Google News significantly impacts media traffic, making it a crucial destination for content SEO strategy. The Google News Initiative provides funding and technology support to help journalism organizations navigate the digital transition.
pengpai: The Paper (澎湃新闻) is a digital news platform operated by Shanghai United Media Group, known for serious investigative journalism, in-depth political analysis, and public policy coverage that represents some of the highest standards of news professionalism in Chinese media. Specialized channels cover governance, ideas, international affairs, and finance with greater depth than most Chinese news outlets. The Wenzhenq (问政) feature connects government departments with the public, representing an innovative attempt at governance transparency. The Global Bureau delivers high-quality international reporting. The Paper attracts readers who prioritize news quality and journalistic integrity, and has become a respected model for how Chinese legacy media can successfully transition to a digital-first news operation while maintaining editorial rigor.
caixin: Caixin is China's most respected independent financial news organization, distinguished by strong editorial independence, rigorous reporting standards, and deep investigative journalism. The paywall model — one of very few successfully commercialized news subscriptions in China — reflects the genuine value readers place on Caixin's trustworthy financial reporting. Caixin Media's flagship weekly magazine and website carry enormous influence among China's business elite, institutional investors, and policy researchers. Caixin's investigative work on P2P lending collapses, COVID-19 early coverage, and corporate fraud cases has produced some of China's most significant journalism. For institutional investors, business executives, and academics requiring reliable, accurate Chinese financial information, Caixin's subscription represents the gold standard in credible Chinese-language financial journalism.
tmall: Tmall is Alibaba's B2C brand flagship store platform, functioning as China's premier destination for purchasing authentic branded goods from over 200,000 domestic and international brands. Unlike Taobao's merchant diversity, Tmall focuses on established brands with verified authenticity, making it the trusted channel for shoppers prioritizing genuine products from official sources. Tmall's Double 11 shopping festival achieved over 490 billion RMB in 2023 GMV. Tmall International handles cross-border imports, allowing domestic consumers to purchase directly from overseas brand stores. Tmall Supermarket competes with JD for same-day and next-day grocery delivery. For international brands entering the Chinese market, opening a Tmall flagship store has become the standard first step in China e-commerce strategy.
dewu: Dewu (得物) is China's definitive marketplace for limited-edition sneakers, streetwear, collectibles, and lifestyle goods, built around a professional authentication system that creates a trust foundation for trading premium items at scale. With over 200 million monthly active users, Dewu commands extraordinary loyalty among Gen Z consumers and sneaker collectors. The platform's authenticators physically inspect every item before delivery, effectively eliminating the counterfeit risk endemic to China's resale markets. Core categories include limited sneakers, designer apparel, watches, and collectible figurines — products where authenticity verification creates genuine marketplace value.
